sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 1
raw_text: China has lots of stories, but four really stand out: Journey to the West, Outlaws of the Marsh, Dream of the Red Chamber and Romance of Three Kingdoms.
They 1. ________ (call) "The Four Great Classical Novels".
Each tells a story as old as time, filled 2. ________ wisdom, adventures and deep emotions.
Journey to the West takes us on an 3. ________ (amaze) trip.
Monkey King, a clever and famous character, helps his master Xuanzang, a monk, on his journey from China to central Asia and India, to get Buddhist scriptures.
They face many challenges, but with courage and teamwork, they 4. ________ (success) at last.
Outlaws of the Marsh speaks of 108 people.
They team up 5. ________ (fight) against cruel rulers.
They became like brothers, fighting for what's right.
6. ________ (actual), their bravery and friendship encourage us to stand up for what we believe in.
Dream of the Red Chamber tells 7. ________ moving story of love, family and the passing of time.
It is a beautiful 8. ________ sad story about the Jia family's ups and downs.
It reminds us that money and power might not last, and that family and true love matter most.
Romance of the Three Kingdoms is about war and 9. ________ (hero).
It's about brave soldiers and smart leaders fighting for power during a time of chaos.
The story teaches us about loyalty, strategy and the cost of ambition.
The Four Great Novels are treasures of Chinese culture.
They teach us about life, love and the human spirit.
People 10. ________ (tell) them for centuries and many millions of students learn them from the TV and radio programmes, and even from their textbooks.
filled_text: China has lots of stories, but four really stand out: Journey to the West, Outlaws of the Marsh, Dream of the Red Chamber and Romance of Three Kingdoms.
They are called "The Four Great Classical Novels".
Each tells a story as old as time, filled with wisdom, adventures and deep emotions.
Journey to the West takes us on an amazing trip.
Monkey King, a clever and famous character, helps his master Xuanzang, a monk, on his journey from China to central Asia and India, to get Buddhist scriptures.
They face many challenges, but with courage and teamwork, they succeed at last.
Outlaws of the Marsh speaks of 108 people.
They team up to fight against cruel rulers.
They became like brothers, fighting for what's right.
Actually, their bravery and friendship encourage us to stand up for what we believe in.
Dream of the Red Chamber tells a moving story of love, family and the passing of time.
It is a beautiful but sad story about the Jia family's ups and downs.
It reminds us that money and power might not last, and that family and true love matter most.
Romance of the Three Kingdoms is about war and heroes.
It's about brave soldiers and smart leaders fighting for power during a time of chaos.
The story teaches us about loyalty, strategy and the cost of ambition.
The Four Great Novels are treasures of Chinese culture.
They teach us about life, love and the human spirit.
People have told them for centuries and many millions of students learn them from the TV and radio programmes, and even from their textbooks.
filled_text_cn: 中国有很多故事，但有四个尤为突出：《西游记》、《水浒传》、《红楼梦》和《三国演义》。
它们被称为“四大古典名著”。
每一部都讲述了一个古老的故事，充满了智慧、冒险和深刻的情感。
《西游记》带我们踏上了一段令人惊叹的旅程。
孙悟空是一个聪明且著名的角色，他帮助他的师父僧侣玄奘，踏上了从中国前往中亚和印度取经的旅程。
他们面临许多挑战，但凭借勇气和团队合作，他们最终成功了。
《水浒传》讲述了108个人的故事。
他们联合起来对抗残暴的统治者。
他们变得像兄弟一样，为正义而战。
实际上，他们的勇敢和友谊激励我们为自己的信念而站出来。
《红楼梦》讲述了一个关于爱情、家庭和时光流逝的动人故事。
这是一个关于贾家兴衰起伏的美丽而悲伤的故事。
它提醒我们，金钱和权力可能不会持久，而家庭和真爱才是最重要的。
《三国演义》是关于战争和英雄的故事。
它是关于勇敢的士兵和聪明的领袖在乱世中为权力而战的故事。
这个故事教导我们关于忠诚、策略以及野心的代价。
四大名著是中国文化的瑰宝。
它们教导我们关于生活、爱和人类的精神。
几个世纪以来，人们一直在讲述这些故事，数以百万计的学生通过电视、广播节目甚至教科书来学习它们。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:它们被称为“四大古典名著”。此处主语 they 和谓语 call 之间是被动关系，描述客观事实，用一般现在时的被动语态，be 动词用 are。故填 are called。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者且描述客观事实时，使用一般现在时的被动语态 (be done)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:每一部都讲述了一个古老的故事，充满了智慧、冒险和深刻的情感。filled with“充满”。故填 with。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 be filled with 或 filled with 意为“充满……”。

questions.explanation: 句意:《西游记》带我们踏上了一段令人惊叹的旅程。此处修饰名词 trip 用形容词 amazing“令人惊叹的”。故填 amazing。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰物作定语时，通常用 -ing 结尾的形容词（如 amazing）。

questions.explanation: 句意:他们面临许多挑战，但凭借勇气和团队合作，他们最终成功了。本文时态为一般现在时，主语是 they，谓语动词用原形 succeed“成功”。故填 succeed。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时中，当主语是复数代词 (they) 时，谓语动词用原形。

questions.explanation: 句意:他们联合起来对抗残暴的统治者。此处表示目的，作目的状语用动词不定式。故填 to fight。
questions.rule_summary: 表示动作的目的时，通常使用动词不定式 (to do) 作目的状语。

questions.explanation: 句意:实际上，他们的勇敢和友谊激励我们为自己的信念而站出来。此处修饰整个句子用副词 actually“实际上”。故填 Actually。
questions.rule_summary: 副词置于句首，用逗号隔开，用来修饰整个句子，通常由形容词加 -ly 构成。

questions.explanation: 句意:《红楼梦》讲述了一个关于爱情、家庭和时光流逝的动人故事。此处泛指一个感人的故事，moving 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指且以辅音音素开头时，使用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 句意:这是一个关于贾家兴衰起伏的美丽而悲伤的故事。前后两个形容词（beautiful 和 sad）是转折关系，用 but 连接。故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: 当两个形容词或分句之间存在语义上的转折对比关系时，使用并列连词 but。

questions.explanation: 句意:《三国演义》是关于战争和英雄的故事。此处表示泛指用名词复数 heroes“英雄”。故填 heroes。
questions.rule_summary: 当可数名词表示泛指且无限定词修饰时，通常使用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意:几个世纪以来，人们一直在讲述这些故事，数以百万计的学生通过电视、广播节目甚至教科书来学习它们。根据“for centuries”可知句子用现在完成时，主语是 People，助动词用 have。故填 have told。
questions.rule_summary: 由“for + 一段时间”引导的时间状语常与现在完成时 (have/has done) 连用。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 2
raw_text: Fragrances bring people good feelings and happy memories.
In modern society, people often wear perfumes, 11. ________ in ancient China, they wore scented sachets.
Scented sachets, also called fragrant bags, are small cloth bags with colorful patterns in which Chinese medicines and sweet-smelling ingredients 12. ________ (place).
Their history goes back thousands of years.
At first, people prefer red 13. ________ (avoid) diseases and drive away insects by using them.
They put medicine with different effects in sachets for different seasons.
Later, people 14. ________ (sudden) thought it fashionable to wear them.
Xuzhou in Jiangsu has a much 15. ________ (long) history of making sachets than other regions.
Xuzhou sachets are known for their fine embroidery and different 16. ________ (shape).
Xuzhou sachet was listed as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2008.
Wang Xiuying, who wore sachets that her grandma and mother made from 17. ________ early age, is a master of the Xuzhou sachet.
In her teens, she started to design and make sachets 18. ________ (she).
Now, 86-year-old Wang and her relatives run a sachet store in Mazhuang Village, Xuzhou.
As well as being beautiful, they're also good 19. ________ health.
Wang has used over 20 medical herbs and developed her own recipes, which has brought her sachets great popularity among people.
Though making these sachets is never easy, Wang often 20. ________ (present) them as gifts to neighbors and people in need.
filled_text: Fragrances bring people good feelings and happy memories.
In modern society, people often wear perfumes, but in ancient China, they wore scented sachets.
Scented sachets, also called fragrant bags, are small cloth bags with colorful patterns in which Chinese medicines and sweet-smelling ingredients are placed.
Their history goes back thousands of years.
At first, people prefer red to avoid diseases and drive away insects by using them.
They put medicine with different effects in sachets for different seasons.
Later, people suddenly thought it fashionable to wear them.
Xuzhou in Jiangsu has a much longer history of making sachets than other regions.
Xuzhou sachets are known for their fine embroidery and different shapes.
Xuzhou sachet was listed as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2008.
Wang Xiuying, who wore sachets that her grandma and mother made from an early age, is a master of the Xuzhou sachet.
In her teens, she started to design and make sachets herself.
Now, 86-year-old Wang and her relatives run a sachet store in Mazhuang Village, Xuzhou.
As well as being beautiful, they're also good for health.
Wang has used over 20 medical herbs and developed her own recipes, which has brought her sachets great popularity among people.
Though making these sachets is never easy, Wang often presents them as gifts to neighbors and people in need.
filled_text_cn: 香味给人们带来美好的感觉和快乐的回忆。
在现代社会，人们经常使用香水，而在古代中国，他们佩戴香包。
香包，也称为香袋，是带有彩色图案的小布袋，里面放置了中药和芳香成分。
它们的历史可以追溯到几千年前。
起初，人们更喜欢红色以避免疾病和驱赶昆虫。
不同季节，他们把具有不同功效的药物放入香包中。
后来，人们突然觉得佩戴香包很时尚。
江苏徐州制作香包的历史比其他地区要长得多。
徐州香包以其精美的刺绣和不同的形状而闻名。
徐州香包于2008年被列为国家级非物质文化遗产。
从小就佩戴祖母和母亲制作的香包的王秀英，是徐州香包大师。
十几岁时，她开始自己设计和制作香包。
现在，86岁的王秀英和亲戚在徐州马庄村经营着一家香包店。
它们不仅美丽，而且对健康也有好处。
王秀英使用了20多种草药并研发了自己的配方，这使她的香包深受人们喜爱。
虽然制作这些香包并不容易，但王秀英经常把它们作为礼物送给邻居和需要帮助的人。

questions.explanation: 句意：在现代社会，人们经常使用香水，而在古代中国，他们佩戴香包。根据“In modern society, people often wear perfumes”和“in ancient China, they wore scented sachets”可知，前后是转折关系，but“然而”符合语境。故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: 前后分句存在语义转折时，应用并列连词 but 连接。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：香包，也称为香袋，是带有彩色图案的小布袋，里面放置了中药和芳香成分。此处是定语从句的谓语动词，主语 Chinese medicines and sweet-smelling ingredients 和动词 place 之间是动宾关系，故用被动语态 be done，表示中药和芳香成分被放置在香包中；时态是一般现在时，主语是复数，be 动词用 are，place 的过去分词是 placed。故填 are placed。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者时，谓语动词应用被动语态（be done）。

questions.explanation: 句意：起初，人们更喜欢红色以避免疾病和驱赶昆虫。此处需要一个不定式表示目的。故填 to avoid。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式（to do）常在句中作目的状语，表示“为了……”。

questions.explanation: 句意：后来，人们突然觉得佩戴香包很时尚。此处需要一个副词修饰动词 thought，sudden 的副词形式是 suddenly“突然的”。故填 suddenly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或整个句子，形容词加 -ly 通常变副词。

questions.explanation: 句意：江苏徐州制作香包的历史比其他地区要长得多。由 than 可知此处需要一个比较级，long 的比较级是 longer。故填 longer。
questions.rule_summary: 句中出现 than 进行两者比较时，形容词或副词应用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：徐州香包以其精美的刺绣和不同的形状而闻名。different 后加复数名词。故填 shapes。
questions.rule_summary: 当可数名词前有 different 等修饰词表泛指或复数概念时，名词应用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：从小就佩戴祖母和母亲制作的香包的王秀英，是徐州香包大师。此处需要一个不定冠词，表示“一个”早期的年龄，且 early 发音以元音音素开头。故填 an。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指时，若其发音以元音音素开头，其前应用不定冠词 an。

questions.explanation: 句意：十几岁时，她开始自己设计和制作香包。此处需要一个反身代词，表示她自己设计和制作香包，she 的反身代词是 herself“她自己”。故填 herself。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语与宾语指代同一人，或强调独立完成某动作时，应用反身代词。

questions.explanation: 句意：它们不仅美丽，而且对健康也有好处。此处需要一个介词，表示对健康有益；be good for“对......有益”，固定搭配。故填 for。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 be good for 表示“对……有好处/有益”，介词应用 for。

questions.explanation: 句意：虽然制作这些香包并不容易，但王秀英经常把它们作为礼物送给邻居和需要帮助的人。由 often 是一般现在时，且主语是三单，动词用三单形式。故填 presents。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时中，当主语为第三人称单数且动作经常发生时，谓语动词应用第三人称单数形式。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 3
raw_text: With four stories forming four concentric circles, the building has over 400 rooms.
Sleeping in one room per night, you may stay here for over a year.
The wonderful earthen building can 21. ________ (perfect) house 600 people.
The Chengqi Building, a tulou or earthen house, 22. ________ (build) in the Qing Dynasty in Yongding County, Longyan, Fujian Province.
As 23. ________ tallest and oldest earthen building in the province, the locals call it the "King of Tulous".
The building protected people from wars, and 24. ________ (it) residents residents were so smart and hardworking that they used the limited farmland 25. ________ (grow) rice and tea.
The buildings are designed 26. ________ top to bottom and each family has two or three rooms on each floor.
A whole village or clan lives in a tulou.
And 27. ________ (family) live close to each other, showing a certain form of clan living and culture.
The earthen buildings look simple outside, 28. ________ they have clever designs inside.
Tourists, who are interested in the tulou, love to come to the 29. ________ (amaze) building.
Today, many of the first-floor rooms are working as small shops selling local products such as tea.
The friendly tulou residents often invite visitors to sit down and take a break.
### --- PRINTED PAGE 61 ---
In recent years, as tourism develops, the local way of life 30. ________ (change), and so has the fate of the tulou.
Today, Fujian is home to about 3,000 tulous.
They are now better protected and used.
filled_text: With four stories forming four concentric circles, the building has over 400 rooms.
Sleeping in one room per night, you may stay here for over a year.
The wonderful earthen building can perfectly house 600 people.
The Chengqi Building, a tulou or earthen house, was built in the Qing Dynasty in Yongding County, Longyan, Fujian Province.
As the tallest and oldest earthen building in the province, the locals call it the "King of Tulous".
The building protected people from wars, and its residents were so smart and hardworking that they used the limited farmland to grow rice and tea.
The buildings are designed from top to bottom and each family has two or three rooms on each floor.
A whole village or clan lives in a tulou.
And families live close to each other, showing a certain form of clan living and culture.
The earthen buildings look simple outside, but they have clever designs inside.
Tourists, who are interested in the tulou, love to come to the amazing building.
Today, many of the first-floor rooms are working as small shops selling local products such as tea.
The friendly tulou residents often invite visitors to sit down and take a break.
### --- PRINTED PAGE 61 ---
In recent years, as tourism develops, the local way of life has changed, and so has the fate of the tulou.
Today, Fujian is home to about 3,000 tulous.
They are now better protected and used.
filled_text_cn: 这座建筑有四层，由四个同心圆组成，拥有400多间房间。
如果每晚睡一间房，你在这里住的时间可能会超过一年。
这座奇妙的土楼可以完美容纳600人。
承启楼是一座土楼，建于清代福建龙岩永定县。
作为省内最高、最古老的土楼，当地人称之为“土楼之王”。
它曾保护居民免受战争侵扰，居民们聪明勤劳，利用有限的耕地种植水稻和茶叶。
土楼的设计自上而下，每户家庭在每层有两到三间房。
一个村庄或一个宗族的人共同生活在土楼里。
家族间比邻而居，展现了独特的宗族生活和文化形式。
土楼外观朴素，但内部设计巧妙。
对土楼感兴趣的游客喜欢参观这座令人惊叹的建筑。
今天，许多一层房间都被用作售卖茶叶等当地特产的小商店。
热情的土楼居民经常邀请游客坐下来休息一会儿。
### --- PRINTED PAGE 61 ---
近年来，随着旅游业发展，当地生活方式和土楼的命运发生了改变。
今天，福建拥有约3000座土楼。
它们现在得到了更好的保护和利用。

questions.explanation: 句意:这座奇妙的土楼可以完美容纳600人。根据“house 600 people”可知，此处应用副词修饰动词，perfect 的副词形式为 perfectly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或整个句子。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意:承启楼是一座土楼，建于清代福建龙岩永定县。根据“in the Qing Dynasty”可知，句子时态是一般过去时，主语“The Chengqi Building”与谓语动词之间是被动关系，主语是单数，故填 was built。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者且发生在过去时，应用一般过去时的被动语态(was/were done)。

questions.explanation: 句意:作为省内最高、最古老的土楼，当地人称之为“土楼之王”。形容词最高级“tallest and oldest”前必须加定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词最高级前通常需加定冠词 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 句意:它曾保护居民免受战争侵扰，居民们聪明勤劳...。空后有名词“residents”，需用形容词性物主代词修饰，it 的形容词性物主代词是 its。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词时用形容词性物主代词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意:居民们利用有限的耕地种植水稻和茶叶。固定搭配 use sth. to do sth. 意为“使用某物做某事”，故填动词不定式 to grow。
questions.rule_summary: use sth. to do sth. 表示“利用某物做某事”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意:土楼的设计自上而下，每户家庭在每层有两到三间房。固定短语 from top to bottom 意为“从上到下”，故填介词 from。
questions.rule_summary: from top to bottom 是固定介词短语，意为“从上到下”。

questions.explanation: 句意:家族间比邻而居，展现了独特的宗族生活和文化形式。根据谓语动词“live”是原形可知，主语应为复数形式，family 的复数形式为 families。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是可数名词且谓语动词为原形时，主语需用复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and / but / or / so)
questions.explanation: 句意:土楼外观朴素，但内部设计巧妙。前半句说外观朴素，后半句说内部设计巧妙，前后分句构成转折关系，故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: 前后分句意思相反或构成转折时，用并列连词 but。

questions.explanation: 句意:对土楼感兴趣的游客喜欢参观这座令人惊叹的建筑。此处修饰名词 building，表示“令人惊叹的”，应用 -ing 形容词 amazing。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰物时通常用 -ing 形式的形容词。

questions.explanation: 句意:近年来，随着旅游业发展，当地生活方式和土楼的命运发生了改变。根据时间标志词“In recent years”（近年来）可知，句子应用现在完成时(have/has done)，主语“the local way of life”是单数，故填 has changed。
questions.rule_summary: 看到 In recent years 等标志词，通常使用现在完成时。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 4
raw_text: Huang Xuhua, a great Chinese scientist, left us 31. ________ February 6th, 2025.
Known as the "Father of China's Nuclear Submarines", he gave all his life to the 32. ________ (develop) of advanced technology for China.
Born in 1926, he joined 33. ________ secret team in 1958 to design China's first nuclear submarine.
At that time, the task 34. ________ (seem) almost impossible because of many difficulties.
For many years, Huang worked day 35. ________ night.
He and other scientists did a lot of research, and they often stayed 36. ________ late to solve problems.
Their hard work 37. ________ (final) succeeded in 1970 when China's first nuclear submarine was launched.
This was a great moment for China.
Huang's family knew nothing about his work for nearly 30 38. ________ (year).
Although he missed many family events, he felt proud to serve our country.
In 2019, he was honored with the Medal of the Republic, China's 39. ________ (high) honor for his extraordinary contributions.
Now all of us 40. ________ (move) by Huang's story.
Chinese people, especially the younger generation, will remember him forever.
filled_text: Huang Xuhua, a great Chinese scientist, left us on February 6th, 2025.
Known as the "Father of China's Nuclear Submarines", he gave all his life to the development of advanced technology for China.
Born in 1926, he joined a secret team in 1958 to design China's first nuclear submarine.
At that time, the task seemed almost impossible because of many difficulties.
For many years, Huang worked day and night.
He and other scientists did a lot of research, and they often stayed up late to solve problems.
Their hard work finally succeeded in 1970 when China's first nuclear submarine was launched.
This was a great moment for China.
Huang's family knew nothing about his work for nearly 30 years.
Although he missed many family events, he felt proud to serve our country.
In 2019, he was honored with the Medal of the Republic, China's highest honor for his extraordinary contributions.
Now all of us are moved by Huang's story.
Chinese people, especially the younger generation, will remember him forever.
filled_text_cn: 黄旭华，一位伟大的中国科学家，于2025年2月6日离开了我们。
被称为“中国核潜艇之父”，他毕生致力于中国先进技术的发展。
出生于1926年，他于1958年加入一个秘密团队，设计中国第一艘核潜艇。
当时，由于许多困难，这项任务似乎几乎不可能完成。
多年来，黄旭华夜以继日地工作。
他和其他科学家做了很多研究，他们经常熬夜解决问题。
他们的辛勤工作最终在1970年取得成功，当时中国第一艘核潜艇下水。
对中国来说，这是一个伟大的时刻。
黄旭华的家人对他的工作一无所知近30年。
虽然他错过了许多家庭活动，但他为能服务祖国感到自豪。
2019年，他被授予共和国勋章，这是中国对他杰出贡献的最高荣誉。
现在我们所有人都被黄旭华的故事感动。
中国人民，尤其是年轻一代，将永远铭记他。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：黄旭华，一位伟大的中国科学家，于2025年2月6日离开了我们。根据“February 6th, 2025”可知，具体日期前用介词 on。故填 on。
questions.rule_summary: 具体日期前通常使用介词 on。

questions.explanation: 句意：被称为“中国核潜艇之父”，他毕生致力于中国先进技术的发展。根据“the”和“of”可知，此处需填名词形式。develop 的名词形式是 development。故填 development。
questions.rule_summary: 定冠词 the 与介词 of 之间通常用名词形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：出生于1926年，他于1958年加入一个秘密团队，设计中国第一艘核潜艇。根据“secret team”可知，此处泛指“一个团队”，且 secret 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指可数名词单数且以辅音音素开头时用 a。

questions.explanation: 句意：当时，由于许多困难，这项任务似乎几乎不可能完成。根据“At that time”可知，时态为一般过去时，动词用过去式 seemed。故填 seemed。
questions.rule_summary: 由过去时间状语标志的句子用一般过去时。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and / but / or / so)
questions.explanation: 句意：多年来，黄旭华夜以继日地工作。固定搭配“day and night”表示“夜以继日”。故填 and。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 day and night 意为夜以继日。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：他和其他科学家做了很多研究，他们经常熬夜解决问题。固定搭配“stay up late”表示“熬夜”。故填 up。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 stay up late 意为熬夜。

questions.explanation: 句意：他们的辛勤工作最终在1970年取得成功。根据“succeeded”可知，此处需用副词修饰动词，final 的副词形式是 finally。故填 finally。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词作状语。

questions.explanation: 句意：黄旭华的家人对他的工作一无所知近30年。根据“30”可知，year 需用复数形式 years。故填 years。
questions.rule_summary: 基数词（大于1）修饰可数名词时，名词用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：2019年，他被授予共和国勋章，这是中国对他杰出贡献的最高荣誉。根据“China's”和“honor”可知，此处需用形容词最高级 highest 修饰，表示“最高荣誉”。故填 highest。
questions.rule_summary: 在一定范围内表示“最……”时，形容词用最高级形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：现在我们所有人都被黄旭华的故事感动。根据“Now”和“by”可知，此处需用被动语态，主语是“all of us”，句子是一般现在时，谓语用 are moved。故填 are moved。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者且伴有 by 动作执行者时，应用被动语态。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 5
raw_text: If you're in Wuhan, a must-see is the Yellow Crane Tower.
It stands on the banks of the Yangtze River at the top of Snake Hill, and is surprisingly 41. ________ (beauty).
It goes without saying that it is one of Hubei's 42. ________ (popular) tourists places.
The history of the Yellow Crane Tower, or Huanghe Lou in Chinese, dates back to the three Kingdoms period 43. ________ Chinese history.
Firstly built in 223 AD, the tower served for military purposes as a watchtower at the 44. ________ (begin).
In the following centuries, it repeatedly saw both destruction 45. ________ reconstruction.
Especially during the Ming and Qing dynasties, it 46. ________ (destroy) seven times.
Yet, each time, it was brought back to life again.
47. ________ (luck), a fire in 1884 completely ruined the building.
It was not until 1981 that the tower was once again rebuilt, which took four years.
The tower we see today is based on the one designed during the Qing Dynasty.
48. ________ poem of the same name makes the tower famous.
The reason why Yellow Crane Tower is so well-known and famous has a lot to do with a widespread poem 49. ________ (write) by Chinese poet Cui Hao in Tang Dynasty.
Named "Yellow Crane Tower", the poem 50. ________ (quick) made the tower widely recognized across the nation.
Today, this poem is listed as one of the masterpieces in Chinese poetry, and is also a must-learn piece for Chinese kids at school.
filled_text: If you're in Wuhan, a must-see is the Yellow Crane Tower.
It stands on the banks of the Yangtze River at the top of Snake Hill, and is surprisingly beautiful.
It goes without saying that it is one of Hubei's most popular tourists places.
The history of the Yellow Crane Tower, or Huanghe Lou in Chinese, dates back to the three Kingdoms period in Chinese history.
Firstly built in 223 AD, the tower served for military purposes as a watchtower at the beginning.
In the following centuries, it repeatedly saw both destruction and reconstruction.
Especially during the Ming and Qing dynasties, it was destroyed seven times.
Yet, each time, it was brought back to life again.
Unluckily, a fire in 1884 completely ruined the building.
It was not until 1981 that the tower was once again rebuilt, which took four years.
The tower we see today is based on the one designed during the Qing Dynasty.
A poem of the same name makes the tower famous.
The reason why Yellow Crane Tower is so well-known and famous has a lot to do with a widespread poem written by Chinese poet Cui Hao in Tang Dynasty.
Named "Yellow Crane Tower", the poem quickly made the tower widely recognized across the nation.
Today, this poem is listed as one of the masterpieces in Chinese poetry, and is also a must-learn piece for Chinese kids at school.
filled_text_cn: 如果你在武汉，一个必看的地方就是黄鹤楼。
它矗立在长江岸边，蛇山之巅，美得令人惊讶。
不用说，它是湖北最受欢迎的旅游景点之一。
黄鹤楼的历史可以追溯到中国历史上的三国时期。
该塔最初建于公元223年，最初是作为军事用途的瞭望塔。
在接下来的几个世纪里，它反复遭到破坏和重建。
特别是在明清时期，它被摧毁了七次。
然而，每一次，它都重获新生。
不幸的是，1884年的一场大火完全摧毁了这座建筑。
直到1981年，这座塔才再次重建，历时四年。
我们今天看到的塔是基于清代设计的那座建造的。
一首同名诗让这座塔闻名。
黄鹤楼之所以如此出名，与唐代诗人崔颢写的一首广为流传的诗有很大关系。
这首名为《黄鹤楼》的诗很快使这座塔在全国广为人知。
今天，这首诗被列为中国诗歌的杰作之一，也是中国孩子们在学校必学的篇目。

questions.explanation: 句意：它矗立在长江岸边，蛇山之巅，美得令人惊讶。根据“is surprisingly”可知，此处需要使用形容词 beautiful 作表语，表示“美丽的”。
questions.rule_summary: 系动词后通常接形容词作表语。

questions.explanation: 句意：不用说，它是湖北最受欢迎的旅游景点之一。根据“one of Hubei's”可知，此处使用形容词 popular 的最高级 most popular，与 one of 构成固定搭配“最……之一”。
questions.rule_summary: one of + the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词表示“最……之一”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：黄鹤楼的历史可以追溯到中国历史上的三国时期。根据“...Chinese history”可知，表示“在中国历史上”时应使用介词 in。
questions.rule_summary: 在某段历史或某个时期中通常用介词 in。

questions.explanation: 句意：该塔最初建于公元223年，最初是作为军事用途的瞭望塔。根据“at the”可知，此处需填名词 beginning，构成固定短语 at the beginning（起初，最初）。
questions.rule_summary: at the beginning 是常用介词短语，意为“起初、开始”。

questions.explanation: 句意：在接下来的几个世纪里，它反复遭到破坏和重建。根据“both destruction...reconstruction”可知，both...and... 是固定搭配，表示“既……又……”。
questions.rule_summary: both... and ... 表示“既……又……”，连接并列成分。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 句意：特别是在明清时期，它被摧毁了七次。根据“during the Ming and Qing dynasties”可知应用一般过去时，且主语 it 与 destroy 之间是被动关系，故用一般过去时的被动语态 was destroyed。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者且发生在过去时，用一般过去时的被动语态 (was/were done)。

questions.explanation: 句意：不幸的是，1884年的一场大火完全摧毁了这座建筑。根据句意以及逗号隔开修饰全句的用法，此处应用否定副词 unluckily 作状语，表示“不幸的是”。
questions.rule_summary: 置于句首修饰整个句子的副词通常用逗号隔开，表示某种情感或评价。

questions.explanation: 句意：一首同名诗让这座塔闻名。此处表示泛指“一首”，且 poem 是以辅音音素开头的可数名词单数，需用不定冠词 A。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指可数名词单数且以辅音音素开头时用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 句意：黄鹤楼之所以如此出名，与唐代诗人崔颢写的一首广为流传的诗有很大关系。poem 与 write 之间是被动关系，故用过去分词 written 作后置定语修饰 poem。
questions.rule_summary: 非谓语动词作后置定语时，若名词与动词是被动关系，用过去分词 (done)。

questions.explanation: 句意：这首名为《黄鹤楼》的诗很快使这座塔在全国广为人知。此处修饰动词 made，应用副词 quickly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或整个句子。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 6
raw_text: China's humanoid robots have improved greatly, as shown by two 2025 events: the Spring Festival Gala and a robot marathon.
At the Gala, 16 robots, made by Unitree, performed a 51. ________ (tradition) dance.
Dressed in red costumes, they moved arms, twisted bodies, and waved handkerchiefs perfectly to the Yangko music.
It is reported that they use AI 52. ________ (hear) rhythms and plan steps.
This was not their first time on stage—robot dogs from the same company 53. ________ (see) dancing at the 2021 Gala.
54. ________ April 2025, a humanoid robot half-marathon was held in Beijing.
20 teams of robots from different places joined this event, with the fastest finishing in 2 hours and 40 minutes.
Though they moved 55. ________ (slow), the marathon was designed to test their 56. ________ (ability).
Some robots' joints got too hot, and others ran out of power quickly, 57. ________ engineers ran beside them to help.
This teamwork has become key to robotics progress.
Chinese companies like Unitree and TianGong have supported these advances.
58. ________ (they) robots are now used in factories and homes, with prices dropping below ¥200,000.
These achievements show that China 59. ________ (make) great progress in the development of humanoid robots.
With continuous innovation and development, humanoid robots will play 60. ________ important role in various fields in the future.
filled_text: China's humanoid robots have improved greatly, as shown by two 2025 events: the Spring Festival Gala and a robot marathon.
At the Gala, 16 robots, made by Unitree, performed a traditional dance.
Dressed in red costumes, they moved arms, twisted bodies, and waved handkerchiefs perfectly to the Yangko music.
It is reported that they use AI to hear rhythms and plan steps.
This was not their first time on stage—robot dogs from the same company were seen dancing at the 2021 Gala.
In April 2025, a humanoid robot half-marathon was held in Beijing.
20 teams of robots from different places joined this event, with the fastest finishing in 2 hours and 40 minutes.
Though they moved slowly, the marathon was designed to test their abilities.
Some robots' joints got too hot, and others ran out of power quickly, so engineers ran beside them to help.
This teamwork has become key to robotics progress.
Chinese companies like Unitree and TianGong have supported these advances.
Their robots are now used in factories and homes, with prices dropping below ¥200,000.
These achievements show that China has made great progress in the development of humanoid robots.
With continuous innovation and development, humanoid robots will play an important role in various fields in the future.
filled_text_cn: 中国的人形机器人取得了巨大进步，2025年的两场活动证明了这一点：春节联欢晚会和机器人马拉松。
在春晚舞台上，由宇树科技制造的16个机器人表演了一场传统舞蹈。
它们身着红色服装，随着秧歌音乐完美地摆动双臂、扭动身体、挥舞手帕。
据报道，它们利用人工智能来听节奏并规划舞步。
这不是它们第一次登上舞台——来自同一家公司的机器狗曾在2021年的春晚上被看到跳舞。
2025年4月，一场人形机器人半程马拉松在北京举行。
来自不同地方的20支机器人团队参加了此次活动，最快的在2小时40分钟内完成了比赛。
虽然它们移动得很慢，但这场马拉松旨在测试它们的能力。
一些机器人的关节变得太热，而另一些很快就没电了，所以工程师们在它们旁边奔跑来提供帮助。
这种团队合作已成为机器人技术进步的关键。
宇树科技和天工等中国公司支持了这些进展。
它们的机器人现在被用于工厂和家庭，价格降到了20万元以下。
这些 achievements 表明中国在人形机器人的发展方面已经取得了巨大的进步。
随着不断的创新和发展，人形机器人未来将在各个领域发挥重要作用。

questions.explanation: 句意：在联欢晚会上，由宇树科技制造的16个机器人表演了一场传统舞蹈。空处需要形容词来修饰名词“dance”，“tradition”的形容词形式是“traditional”，表示“传统的”。
questions.rule_summary: 名词变形容词作定语修饰名词。

questions.explanation: 句意：据报道，它们利用人工智能来听节奏并规划舞步。“use...to do sth.”是固定用法，表示“使用……来做某事”，所以此处要用动词不定式形式。
questions.rule_summary: use sth. to do sth. 表示使用某物做某事。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：这不是它们第一次登上舞台——来自同一家公司的机器狗曾在2021年的联欢晚会上被看到跳舞。句子主语“robot dogs”和谓语动词“see”之间是被动关系，且时间是“2021”，是过去的时间，所以要用一般过去时的被动语态，其结构是“was/were + 过去分词”，主语是复数，用“were seen”。
questions.rule_summary: 主语与动词为被动关系且动作发生在过去时，用一般过去时的被动语态。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：2025年4月，一场人形机器人半程马拉松在北京举行。在具体年份或月份前要用介词“in”，句首单词首字母大写。
questions.rule_summary: 月份或年份前通常使用介词 in。

questions.explanation: 句意：虽然它们移动得很慢，但这场马拉松旨在测试它们的能力。此处需要一个副词来修饰动词“moved”，“slow”的副词形式是“slowly”，表示“缓慢地”。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词，表示动作的状态。

questions.explanation: 句意：虽然它们移动得很慢，但这场马拉松旨在测试它们的能力。这里说的“能力”不止一种，应该用复数形式“abilities”。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指多种能力或可数名词复数形式的运用。

questions.explanation: 句意：一些机器人的关节变得太热，而另一些很快就没电了，所以工程师们在它们旁边奔跑来提供帮助。前后句子是因果关系，前面是原因，后面是结果，所以用连词“so”，表示“所以”。
questions.rule_summary: 前因后果时，使用连词 so 连接结果分句。

questions.explanation: 句意：它们的机器人现在被用于工厂和家庭，价格降到了20万元以下。此处需要一个形容词性物主代词来修饰名词“robots”，“they”的形容词性物主代词是“their”，表示“它们的”，句首首字母大写。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词用形容词性物主代词。

questions.explanation: 句意：这些成就表明中国在人形机器人的发展方面已经取得了巨大的进步。此处强调过去的动作对现在造成的影响（已经取得了进步），要用现在完成时，其结构是“have/has + 过去分词”，主语是“China”，所以用“has made”。
questions.rule_summary: 强调过去发生的事对现在产生的影响，用现在完成时。

questions.explanation: 句意：随着不断的创新和发展，人形机器人未来将在各个领域发挥重要作用。“play an important role”是固定短语，表示“发挥重要作用”，“important”的发音是以元音音素开头，所以用不定冠词“an”。
questions.rule_summary: 元音音素开头的单数可数名词前用 an。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 7
raw_text: In the US, baseball players spread special mud on their balls before games. It comes from New Jersey,
near 61. ________ Delaware River.
Very few people know exactly where it is.
The mud 62. ________ (say) to have "magic" and help players win.
But is it 63. ________ (real) magical?
Is there any science behind it?
64. ________ 2019, scientists from the University of Pennsylvania in the US have studied the mud.
They found the mud is different from other mud.
It feels like sandpaper 65. ________ moves like cream.
To understand why, the scientists used special tools to see how the mud moves.
The result made 66. ________ (they) excited.
They found the mud is very fine.
It is also sticky, but 67. ________ (get) less so when it dries.
The scientists also wanted to know if the mud helps players hold a baseball better.
So they made a special thing that was like human fingers.
They then used it to spread the mud on a baseball and found that the friction was 68. ________ (strong).
So the mud makes it easier to hold a baseball and keeps it from slipping out of 69. ________ (player) hands.

filled_text: In the US, baseball players spread special mud on their balls before games. It comes from New Jersey,
near the Delaware River.
Very few people know exactly where it is.
The mud is said to have "magic" and help players win.
But is it really magical?
Is there any science behind it?
Since 2019, scientists from the University of Pennsylvania in the US have studied the mud.
They found the mud is different from other mud.
It feels like sandpaper but moves like cream.
To understand why, the scientists used special tools to see how the mud moves.
The result made them excited.
They found the mud is very fine.
It is also sticky, but gets less so when it dries.
The scientists also wanted to know if the mud helps players hold a baseball better.
So they made a special thing that was like human fingers.
They then used it to spread the mud on a baseball and found that the friction was stronger.

The scientists were surprised to find out so many amazing facts about the mud.

filled_text_cn: 在美国，棒球运动员在比赛前会在球上涂上特殊的泥浆。它来自新泽西，
靠近特拉华河。
极少有人确切知道它在哪里。
据说这种泥浆有“魔力”，可以帮助运动员获胜。
但是它真的有魔力吗？
这背后有什么科学依据吗？
自从2019年以来，美国宾夕法尼亚大学的科学家们一直在研究这种泥浆。
他们发现这种泥浆与其他泥浆不同。
它感觉像砂纸，但像奶油一样移动。
为了解开其中的原因，科学家们使用特殊工具来观察泥浆是如何移动的。
这个结果使他们很兴奋。
他们发现泥浆非常细腻。
它也很粘，但干燥后就变得不那么粘了。
科学家们还想知道泥浆是否有助于运动员更好地握住棒球。
于是他们制作了一个类似于人类手指的特殊物品。
然后他们用它把泥浆涂在棒球上，发现摩擦力更强了。
因此，泥浆使握住棒球变得更容易，并防止它从球员的手中滑落。
科学家们惊讶地发现了关于这种泥浆的那么多惊人事实。
他们认为他们的研究对人们是一种启发，并希望更多的人去研究自然事物。
记住，万物背后皆有科学。

questions.explanation: 句意：它来自新泽西，靠近特拉华河。the Delaware River“特拉华河”，专有名词前应用定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: 特指前文提过的人/物、独一无二的事物或江河海洋等专有名词前用 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：据说这种泥浆有“魔力”，可以帮助运动员获胜。主语 The mud 和动词 say 之间是被动关系，应用被动语态（be said to do sth“据说做某事”）；句子时态为一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，故填 is said。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者时，根据时态使用相应的 be + done 结构。

questions.explanation: 句意：但是它真的有魔力吗？此处需要用副词 really“真正地”来修饰形容词 magical。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰形容词、副词或动词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：自从2019年以来，美国宾夕法尼亚大学的科学家们一直在研究这种泥浆。根据后面的时态“have studied”（现在完成时）可知，应填介词 since“自从”，且位于句首首字母需大写。
questions.rule_summary: 现在完成时常与 since 引导的时间点连用表示从过去某一时间开始一直持续到现在的动作。

questions.explanation: 句意：它感觉像砂纸，但像奶油一样移动。根据前文“It feels like sandpaper”和后文“moves like cream”可知，前后之间是转折关系，所以要用连词 but“但是”。
questions.rule_summary: 连接并列成分或分句表示转折关系时用 but。

questions.explanation: 句意：这个结果使他们很兴奋。分析句子结构可知，代词作动词 make 的宾语，应用 they 的宾格形式 them。
questions.rule_summary: 代词用在动词或介词后面作宾语时，必须用宾格形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：它也很粘，但干燥后就变得不那么粘了。句子描述客观事实和状态，时态为一般现在时；主语是 it，谓语动词应用第三人称单数形式 gets。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时中，当主语是第三人称单数时，动词要加 -s 或 -es。

questions.explanation: 句意：然后，他们用它把泥涂在棒球上，发现摩擦力更强。此处表示与之前相比摩擦力变大，暗含比较意味，应用形容词 strong 的比较级形式 stronger 作表语。
questions.rule_summary: 表示两者相比“更……时”，形容词或副词使用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：所以泥浆使拿住棒球更容易，防止它从球员们的手中滑落。根据语境，此处指代复数“球员们的”，应用名词复数 player 的所有格形式 players' 作定语修饰 hands。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词表示复数所属关系时，以 -s 结尾的名词复数直接加撇（'s）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们认为他们的研究对人们来说是一种启发，并希望更多的人去研究自然事物。wish sb. to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“希望某人做某事”。
questions.rule_summary: 动词 wish 后面常跟带 to 的动词不定式作宾语补足语（wish sb. to do sth.）。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 8
raw_text: When I was a child, I lived on a fruit farm.
We had lots of pear trees and some apple trees.
We had to help my father all through the year.
The 71. ________ (busy) time was in late summer, when the fruit was ready to 72. ________ (pick).
At that time of year, we got up at 4:30 in the morning, started picking at 5:00 and went 73. ________ working until late afternoon.
My mother 74. ________ (bring) lunch for us to have under the trees.
At the end of the day, we were all tired and 75. ________ (sleep)!
My father got many 76. ________ (work) to help pick the fruit.
The more fruit they picked, the more money they were paid.
Lots of them loved eating free fruit.
However, in 77. ________ first few days, they would eat so much fruit 78. ________ they would not want to eat any more for a long time!
It took about five weeks to pick all the fruit.
At night, the fruit was 79. ________ (care) packed into boxes and then put onto trucks.

filled_text: When I was a child, I lived on a fruit farm.
We had lots of pear trees and some apple trees.
We had to help my father all through the year.
The busiest time was in late summer, when the fruit was ready to be picked.
At that time of year, we got up at 4:30 in the morning, started picking at 5:00 and went on working until late afternoon.
My mother brought lunch for us to have under the trees.
At the end of the day, we were all tired and sleepy!
My father got many workers to help pick the fruit.
The more fruit they picked, the more money they were paid.
Lots of them loved eating free fruit.
However, in the first few days, they would eat so much fruit that they would not want to eat any more for a long time!
It took about five weeks to pick all the fruit.
At night, the fruit was carefully packed into boxes and then put onto trucks.
The trucks took it to the markets to be sold.
Sometimes we rode in the trucks to the city.
For farm boys, that was a very exciting time!
filled_text_cn: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我住在一个人果场里。
我们有很多梨树和一些苹果树。
我们一年到头都得帮父亲的忙。
最忙的时候是夏末，水果可以摘的时候。
在每年的这个时候，我们早上4:30起床，5点开始采摘，一直工作到下午晚些时候。
我妈妈给我们带来了午餐，让我们在树下吃。
在一天结束的时候，我们都又累又困！
我父亲找了许多工人来帮忙摘水果。
他们摘的水果越多，得到的报酬就越多。
他们中的很多人喜欢吃免费的水果。
然而，在最初的几天里，他们会吃很多水果，很长一段时间他们都不想再吃了！
摘完所有的水果大约花了五个星期。
晚上，水果被小心翼翼地装进盒子里，然后放到卡车上。
卡车把它运到市场上去卖。
有时我们坐卡车去城里。
对于农场男孩来说，那是一个非常激动人心的时刻！

questions.explanation: 句意：最忙的时候是夏末，水果可以摘的时候。定冠词“The”修饰最高级，故填 busiest。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词最高级前通常加定冠词the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：最忙的时候是夏末，水果可以摘的时候。本句主语是动作的承受者，用被动语态，be ready to do sth“准备好做某事”，故填 be picked。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者时，应用被动语态 (be done)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：在每年的这个时候，我们早上4:30起床，5点开始采摘，一直工作到下午晚些时候。go on doing sth“继续做某事”，故填 on。
questions.rule_summary: go on doing sth 表示“继续做某事”。

questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈给我们带来了午餐，让我们在树下吃。本句时态是一般过去时，动词用过去式，故填 brought。
questions.rule_summary: 描述过去发生的动作用一般过去时，动词变为过去式。

questions.explanation: 句意：在一天结束的时候，我们都又累又困！此处在句中作表语，用形容词 sleepy“困倦的”，故填 sleepy。
questions.rule_summary: 系动词后常接形容词作表语。

questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲找了许多工人来帮忙摘水果。根据“My father got many...to help pick the fruit.”可知，找工人来摘水果，worker“工人”，many 修饰可数名词复数。故填 workers。
questions.rule_summary: many 修饰可数名词的复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：然而，在最初的几天里，他们会吃很多水果，很长一段时间他们都不想再吃了！序数词前用定冠词 the，故填 the。
questions.rule_summary: 序数词前面通常要加定冠词the。

questions.explanation: 句意：然而，在最初的几天里，他们会吃很多水果，很长一段时间他们都不想再吃了！根据“they would eat so much fruit...they would not want to eat any more for a long time”可知，此处是so...that...结构，故填 that。
questions.rule_summary: so... that... 引导结果状语从句，意为“如此……以至于……”。

questions.explanation: 句意：晚上，水果被小心翼翼地装进盒子里，然后放到卡车上。此处在句中修饰动词，用副词 carefully，故填 carefully。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词，说明动作发生的方式。

questions.explanation: 句意：对于农场男孩来说，那是一个非常激动人心的时刻！此处作定语修饰“time”，用形容词 exciting，故填 exciting。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰物时通常用-ing结尾的形容词（如exciting表示令人激动的）。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 9
raw_text: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) is magic to me, a man from Canada.
My interest 81. ________ it came from my experience.
Years ago, I often had headaches, and my life 82. ________ (influence) to a great degree.
I tried many different methods, but none of them worked.
Luckily, I met with 83. ________ doctor of TCM during my trip in China.
He advised me 84. ________ (take) some Chinese medicine.
So I did.
To my surprise, my pain was gone within a week.
Later, I found that TCM could be 85. ________ (help) to some illnesses lasting for a long time, such as sleeping problems or physical pains.
The effective methods in TCM also took my 86. ________ (wife) interest.
With her support, I'm running a website to introduce TCM.
I did it just because I want to help people understand 87. ________ if they have some health problems, they can try TCM.
All these 88. ________ (experience) with TCM led me to study ancient Chinese philosophy, for many of TCM ideas, such as yin and yang, and qi, were 89. ________ (direct) inspired by it.
Since then, I 90. ________ (step) onto the road to learning about Chinese culture.
filled_text: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) is magic to me, a man from Canada.
My interest in it came from my experience.
Years ago, I often had headaches, and my life was influenced to a great degree.
I tried many different methods, but none of them worked.
Luckily, I met with a doctor of TCM during my trip in China.
He advised me to take some Chinese medicine.
So I did.
To my surprise, my pain was gone within a week.
Later, I found that TCM could be helpful to some illnesses lasting for a long time, such as sleeping problems or physical pains.
The effective methods in TCM also took my wife's interest.
With her support, I'm running a website to introduce TCM.
I did it just because I want to help people understand that if they have some health problems, they can try TCM.
All these experiences with TCM led me to study ancient Chinese philosophy, for many of TCM ideas, such as yin and yang, and qi, were directly inspired by it.
Since then, I have stepped onto the road to learning about Chinese culture.
filled_text_cn: 对一个来自加拿大的男人来说，传统中医药（TCM）对我而言具有神奇的魔力。
我对它的兴趣来源于我的经历。
几年前，我经常头痛，我的生活受到了很大程度的影响。
我尝试了许多不同的方法，但没有一个管用。
幸运的是，我在中国旅行期间遇到了一位中医。
他建议我吃一些中药。
我照做了。
令我惊讶的是，一周内我的疼痛就消失了。
后来，我发现中医对一些长期的疾病有帮助，比如睡眠问题或身体疼痛。
中医中那些有效的方法也引起了我妻子的兴趣。
在她的支持下，我正在运营一个介绍中医的网站。
我这样做只是因为我想帮助人们理解：如果他们遇到健康问题，他们可以尝试中医。
所有这些与中医有关的经历促使我研究中国古代哲学，因为许多中医理念（如阴阳和气）直接受到了它的启发。
自那以后，我踏上了学习中国文化的道路。

questions.explanation: 句意：我对它的兴趣来自我的经历。“对……的兴趣”是固定搭配 interest in，因此填介词 in。
questions.rule_summary: 熟记固定搭配 interest in 表示“对……的兴趣”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：几年前，我经常头痛，我的生活受到了很大程度的影响。“生活”与“影响”之间是被动关系，且由时间状语“Years ago”可知应用一般过去时的被动语态（was/were done），主语 my life 为单数，故填 was influenced。
questions.rule_summary: 根据主语与动词的主被动关系及时间状语确定语态和时态。

questions.explanation: 句意：幸运的是，我在中国旅行时遇到了一位中医。此处表示泛指“一位医生”，且 doctor 以辅音音素开头，应用不定冠词 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指时，辅音音素前用 a。

questions.explanation: 句意：他建议我吃一些中药。“建议某人做某事”是固定搭配 advise sb. to do sth.，因此应用动词不定式 to take。
questions.rule_summary: advise sb. to do sth. 意为“建议某人做某事”。

questions.explanation: 句意：后来，我发现中医对一些长期的疾病有帮助……。空前有情态动词和 be 动词（could be），其后应用形容词作表语，help 的形容词形式为 helpful（有帮助的）。
questions.rule_summary: be 动词后常接形容词作表语。

questions.explanation: 句意：中医有效的方法也引起了我妻子的兴趣。修饰后面的名词 interest，表示“我妻子的”，应用名词所有格形式 wife's。
questions.rule_summary: 名词修饰名词表所属关系时，单数名词加 's。

questions.explanation: 句意：我这样做只是因为我想帮助人们理解，如果他们有一些健康问题，他们可以尝试中医。understand 后引导宾语从句，从句结构完整且不缺成分，因此用引导词 that（在口语中常省略）。
questions.rule_summary: 宾语从句结构完整、无疑问含义时，用 that 引导。

questions.explanation: 句意：所有这些与中医有关的经历促使我研究中国古代哲学……。“experience”作“经历”讲时是可数名词，且其前有 all these 修饰，应用复数形式 experiences。
questions.rule_summary: all these 修饰可数名词复数。

questions.explanation: 句意：因为许多中医理念……直接受到了它的启发。空处修饰动词 inspired，应用副词形式，direct 的副词是 directly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态（现在完成时）
questions.explanation: 句意：从那以后，我踏上了学习中国文化的道路。由“Since then（自那以后）”可知，主句应用现在完成时（have/has done），主语为 I，助动词用 have，故填 have stepped。
questions.rule_summary: Since then 是现在完成时的标志性时间状语。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 10
raw_text: Wearing traditional Chinese clothing, especially Hanfu, has become very popular among tourists in China.
Xi'an, 91. ________ capital of Shaanxi Province in the northwest of China, was once the most important city of 13 dynasties.
Today, visitors enjoy 92. ________ (walk) around the city dressed in Hanfu, the traditional clothing of the Han people.
Both Chinese 93. ________ foreign tourists have fun dressing up in these clothes while exploring the rich culture of the Tang Dynasty.
The Datang Everbright City is a beautiful place where you can see people at all ages in Hanfu.
Every summer, the area offers special photography packages 94. ________ those wanting to take pictures of 95. ________ (they) Hanfu moments.
This 96. ________ (welcome) by many young people today.
Hanfu is not just popular in Xi'an.
In Keqiao, an ancient town in Zhejiang Province, visitors often dress in Hanfu 97. ________ (match) the town's bridges and traditional buildings.
Keqiao also holds Hanfu shows and activities, letting tourists experience the beauty of traditional Chinese culture.
Museums have also joined in.
In Beijing, the China National Arts and Crafts Museum lets visitors try on over 200 98. ________ (kind) of traditional Chinese clothing from different dynasties.

filled_text: Wearing traditional Chinese clothing, especially Hanfu, has become very popular among tourists in China.
Xi'an, the capital of Shaanxi Province in the northwest of China, was once the most important city of 13 dynasties.
Today, visitors enjoy walking around the city dressed in Hanfu, the traditional clothing of the Han people.
Both Chinese and foreign tourists have fun dressing up in these clothes while exploring the rich culture of the Tang Dynasty.
The Datang Everbright City is a beautiful place where you can see people at all ages in Hanfu.
Every summer, the area offers special photography packages to those wanting to take pictures of their Hanfu moments.
This is welcomed by many young people today.
Hanfu is not just popular in Xi'an.
In Keqiao, an ancient town in Zhejiang Province, visitors often dress in Hanfu to match the town's bridges and traditional buildings.
Keqiao also holds Hanfu shows and activities, letting tourists experience the beauty of traditional Chinese culture.
Museums have also joined in.
In Beijing, the China National Arts and Crafts Museum lets visitors try on over 200 kinds of traditional Chinese clothing from different dynasties.
Experts say that wearing Hanfu and joining in related activities really helps tourists understand the deep history and cultural meaning of this traditional clothing.
It also promotes the spread of traditional clothing culture and lets tourists feel the beauty of Chinese.
filled_text_cn: 穿中国传统服装，尤其是汉服，在中国游客中变得非常受欢迎。
西安，中国西北部陕西省的省会，曾是13个朝代最重要的城市。
如今，游客们喜欢穿着汉族的传统服饰汉服在城里漫步。
中国游客和外国游客在探索丰富的唐代文化时，都喜欢穿上这些服饰。
大唐不夜城是一个美丽的地方，在那里你可以看到各个年龄段的人穿着汉服。
每年夏天，该地区为那些想拍摄自己汉服时刻的人提供特别的摄影套餐。
这在今天受到许多年轻人的欢迎。
汉服不仅在西安受欢迎。
在浙江古镇柯桥，游客们经常穿着汉服，与古镇的桥梁和传统建筑相搭配。
柯桥也举办汉服秀和活动，让游客体验中国传统文化之美。
博物馆也加入了进来。
在北京，中国国家工艺美术博物馆让游客试穿200多种不同朝代的中国传统服饰。
专家表示，穿汉服和参加相关活动确实有助于游客了解这种传统服饰的深厚历史和文化意义。
它也促进了传统服装文化的传播，让游客感受到中国文化之美。

questions.explanation: “the capital of...”为固定短语，意为“……的省会/首都”，此处特指陕西省的省会，需用定冠词the。
questions.rule_summary: 特指前文提过的人/物、独一无二的事物、序数词/最高级前用定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: “enjoy doing sth.”为固定用法，意为“喜欢做某事”，walk的动名词形式为walking。
questions.rule_summary: 动词放在介词后或特定动词（如 enjoy, finish）后需用 -ing 形式。

questions.explanation: “both...and...”为固定短语，意为“……和……都”，连接并列成分 Chinese 和 foreign tourists。
questions.rule_summary: both...and... 连接并列成分表示“两者都”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: “offer sth. to sb.”为固定短语，意为“向某人提供某物”，此处表示“为……提供”，用介词to。
questions.rule_summary: 掌握常用动介搭配，如 offer sth. to sb.。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: “moments”为名词，前面需用形容词性物主代词 their 修饰，表示“他们的汉服时刻”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰空后名词用形容词性物主代词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句子主语 This 与 welcome 之间为被动关系，且描述客观事实，用一般现在时的被动语态“be+过去分词”，主语为第三人称单数，be动词用is。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者时用 be + done 的被动语态。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 此处用动词不定式“to match”作目的状语，表示“为了搭配”。
questions.rule_summary: 不定式常可作目的状语，意为“为了……”。

questions.explanation: “over 200”后接可数名词复数，kind的复数形式为kinds，“200 kinds of”意为“200种”。
questions.rule_summary: 当所给词是单数可数名词时，且空前有 2 及以上数字修饰时，名词要用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 根据语境可知，此处需用副词 really 修饰动词 helps，表示“确实，真正地”。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词 (v.+adv. / adv.+v.)。

questions.explanation: “cultural”为形容词，后接名词，mean的名词形式为meaning，此处表示抽象的“意义”，用单数形式。
questions.rule_summary: 根据句子成分，动词可转化为名词。

filled_text: Snakes in Chinese Culture
The year 2025 is the Year of the Snake.
The snake is the sixth of the twelve Chinese zodiac animals.
In the west, the snake is seen as an evil animal or a positive animal sometimes.
In Chinese culture, however, it is seen in a more positive light than the west.
In China, snake is often called small dragon.
The dragon's body is that of a big snake.
For this reason, many people believe that the image of the dragon came from the snake.
Snakes can be seen in many old Chinese stories.

And his younger sister Nü Wa created humans from earth.
Both of them had snake bodies and human heads.

Many of them had something to do with snakes.
For example, the four gods of the sea all wore snakes as earrings and they also traveled on snakes.

One famous story is called Baishe Zhuan or The Legend of the White Snake.
In this story, a magical snake named Bai Suzhen falls in love with a man named Xu Xian.
Bai Suzhen is pictured as a kind and beautiful character.
Yes.
Do you remember "Bai Suzhen" has been in this Spring Festival Gala?
filled_text_cn: 中国文化中的蛇
2025年是蛇年。
蛇是中国十二生肖中的第六个。
在西方，蛇有时被视为邪恶的动物或积极的动物。
然而，在中国文化中，它被视为比西方更积极的一面。
在中国，蛇通常被称为小龙。
龙的身体是大蛇的身体。
出于这个原因，许多人相信龙的形象来自于蛇。
在许多古老的中国故事中都可以看到蛇。
在中国神话中，伏羲是中国人的祖先之一。
他的妹妹女娲从地球上创造了人类。
他们都有蛇的身体和人类的头。
《山海经》中有许多关于神仙的故事。
其中很多都和蛇有关。
例如，四个海神都戴着蛇作为耳环，他们也骑着蛇旅行。
蛇也出现在许多民间故事中。
一个著名的故事叫《白蛇传》或《白蛇传传奇》。
在这个故事中，一条名叫白素贞的有魔力的蛇爱上了一个名叫许仙的男人。
白素贞被描绘成一个善良美丽的人物。
是的。
你还记得“白素贞”上过今年春晚吗？

questions.explanation: 此处修饰序数词“sixth”，特指十二生肖中的第六个，应用定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: 序数词前通常需要加定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: 根据句中的“than”可知，此处表示两者之间的比较，应用 positive 的比较级形式 more positive。
questions.rule_summary: 句中有 than 时，形容词通常用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰名词“body”，表示“龙的身体”，应用名词所有格形式 dragon's。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词表示所属关系时，名词需变为所有格形式（'s）。

questions.explanation: 由“many old Chinese”修饰，可数名词 story 应用复数形式 stories 泛指类别。
questions.rule_summary: many 等词修饰可数名词时，名词应用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 前文提到伏羲是中国人的祖先之一，接着说他的妹妹女娲创造了人类，上下文之间是顺承关系，应用 And 连接，位于句首首字母大写。
questions.rule_summary: 表示顺承、并列关系时，常用并列连词 and。

questions.explanation: “of”为介词，其后接人称代词宾格形式 them 作宾语。
questions.rule_summary: 介词后面的人称代词必须使用宾格形式。

questions.explanation: 句意为“其中很多都和蛇有关”，have something to do with 是固定搭配，意为“与……有关”。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 have something to do with 中使用动词不定式。

questions.explanation: 根据后文“they also traveled on snakes”可知，整句话描述的是过去的事情，应用一般过去时，wear 的过去式为 wore。
questions.rule_summary: 根据上下文语境的时态标志，确定谓语动词用过去时。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: fall in love with 是固定搭配，意为“爱上”，故填介词 in。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 fall in love with 意为“爱上”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 主语 Bai Suzhen 与 picture 之间是被动关系，且陈述客观事实用一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数，故填 is pictured。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者时，谓语动词需用被动语态（be + done）。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 12
raw_text: China plans to send astronauts to the moon by 2030.

The spacesuit 112. ________ (have) red stripes on the arms.
They are inspired by the ribbons of Flying Apsaras.
Flying Apsaras are from Dunhuang art.
Their Chinese name, Feitian, means "flying to 113. ________ sky".
Clearly, the spacesuit shows a wish for the success of China's trip 114. ________ the moon.
Flying Apsaras came from Indian mythology.
In the beginning, there were two gods, Gandharva and Kimnara.
They were husband and wife and took on different 115. ________ (role).
Gandharva's duties 116. ________ (include) spreading holy songs and dances.
Kimnara was in charge of entertainment.
At the end, the two became one—Flying Apsaras.
After spreading to China, Flying Apsaras became part of Chinese art over time.
They appeared in many places 117. ________ they were the most famous in Dunhuang.
A large number of Flying Apsaras 118. ________ (paint) can be found on the walls and ceilings of over 500 caves.

filled_text: China plans to send astronauts to the moon by 2030.
In September 2024, China showed its first moon-landing spacesuit to the public.
The spacesuit has red stripes on the arms.
They are inspired by the ribbons of Flying Apsaras.
Flying Apsaras are from Dunhuang art.
Their Chinese name, Feitian, means "flying to the sky".
Clearly, the spacesuit shows a wish for the success of China's trip to the moon.
Flying Apsaras came from Indian mythology.
In the beginning, there were two gods, Gandharva and Kimnara.
They were husband and wife and took on different roles.
Gandharva's duties included spreading holy songs and dances.
Kimnara was in charge of entertainment.
At the end, the two became one—Flying Apsaras.
After spreading to China, Flying Apsaras became part of Chinese art over time.
They appeared in many places but they were the most famous in Dunhuang.
A large number of Flying Apsaras paintings can be found on the walls and ceilings of over 500 caves.
Dunhuang Flying Apsaras don't have wings.
They fly with the support of floating cloth and colorful ribbons.
Their styles are different in different dynasties.
The earlier the paintings appeared, the more original they were.
Later ones were influenced by other cultures.
Flying Apsaras art reached the top during the Tang Dynasty.
filled_text_cn: 中国计划在2030年以前将宇航员送上月球。
2024年9月，中国向公众展示了它的第一款登月太空服。
太空服的手臂上有红色条纹。
它们的灵感来自于飞天的丝带。
飞天源自敦煌艺术。
它们的中文名字“飞天”，意思是“飞向天空”。
显然，太空服显示了对中国月球之旅成功的祝愿。
飞天源自印度神话。
最初，有两个神，干闼婆和紧那罗。
他们是夫妻，承担着不同的角色。
干闼婆的职责包括传播圣歌和舞蹈。
紧那罗负责娱乐。
最后，两人合二为一——飞天。
流传到中国后，飞天随着时间的推移成为了中国艺术的一部分。
它们出现在许多地方，但在敦煌最为著名。
在500多个洞穴的墙壁和天花板上可以发现大量的飞天绘画。
敦煌飞天没有翅膀。
它们依靠飘带和彩色丝带来飞行。
它们在不同的朝代有不同的风格。
绘画出现得越早，它们就越原始。
后来的画作受到了其他文化的影响。
飞天艺术在唐代达到了顶峰。

questions.explanation: 由 ‘... first moon-landing spacesuit’ 可知，此处应用形容词性物主代词修饰后面的名词。故填 its。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰空后名词用形容词性物主代词。

questions.explanation: 句子描述的是太空服的特征，是一般现在时，The spacesuit 是第三人称单数，谓语动词用第三人称单数 has。故填 has。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时中，主语为第三人称单数时，动词用第三人称单数形式。

questions.explanation: 由 ‘...sky’ 可知，此处应用定冠词 the 表示特指天空。故填 the。
questions.rule_summary: 独一无二的事物前通常用定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: trip to... 表示‘去……的旅行’，为固定搭配。故填 to。
questions.rule_summary: trip to 表示去某地的旅行，属于常用介词固定搭配。

questions.explanation: different 后接可数名词复数。故填 roles。
questions.rule_summary: different 等词修饰可数名词时，名词需用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句子描述的是过去的情况，谓语动词应用过去式，include 的过去式是 included。故填 included。
questions.rule_summary: 叙述过去发生的动作或存在的状态时，谓语动词用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 由 ‘They appeared in many places’ 和 ‘they were the most famous in Dunhuang’ 可知，前后句是转折关系，应用 but ‘但是’ 来连接两个句子。故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: 前后分句存在语义上的转折对比时，用并列连词 but 连接。

questions.explanation: A large number of 后接可数名词复数，paint 的名词形式是 painting，其复数是 paintings。故填 paintings。
questions.rule_summary: a large number of 后接可数名词复数形式。

questions.explanation: 分析句子可知，此处是 ‘the+比较级，the+比较级’ 结构，表示‘越……越……’，early 的比较级是 earlier。故填 earlier。
questions.rule_summary: “the + 比较级 ..., the + 比较级 ...” 结构表示“越……越……”。

questions.explanation: 根据 ‘Later ones...by other cultures’ 可知，此处应该用一般过去时的被动语态，其结构为 ‘was/were+过去分词’。ones 是主语，be 动词用 were，influence 的过去分词是 influenced。故填 were influenced。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者时，结合语境时态使用被动语态（be + done）。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 13
raw_text: In the 2025 Spring Festival Gala, a group of lively human-like robots wearing colorful flowery jackets and red handkerchiefs 121. ________ (catch) the audience's eyes with 122. ________ (they) Yangko dance.
The program was called "YanBOT".
It 123. ________ (direct) by Zhang Yimou.
There were 16 robots and 16 dancers from the Xinjiang Arts Institute in the program.
These robots were named H1.
They had many advanced 124. ________ (technology).
For example, high-precision 3D laser SLAM, self-positioning and navigation, multi-agent cooperation planning, advanced network solutions, and full-body AI motion control.
Because 125. ________ these technologies, the robots could move steadily and do 126. ________ same dance moves together.
The robots could also "know" the music and change their moves 127. ________ (quick) to follow the rhythm.
The robots were designed 128. ________ (look) like skeletons and they didn't have pants.
This was to make a big difference from human dancers.

filled_text: In the 2025 Spring Festival Gala, a group of lively human-like robots wearing colorful flowery jackets and red handkerchiefs caught the audience's eyes with their Yangko dance.
The program was called "YanBOT".
It was directed by Zhang Yimou.
There were 16 robots and 16 dancers from the Xinjiang Arts Institute in the program.
These robots were named H1.
They had many advanced technologies.
For example, high-precision 3D laser SLAM, self-positioning and navigation, multi-agent cooperation planning, advanced network solutions, and full-body AI motion control.
Because of these technologies, the robots could move steadily and do the same dance moves together.
The robots could also "know" the music and change their moves quickly to follow the rhythm.
The robots were designed to look like skeletons and they didn't have pants.
This was to make a big difference from human dancers.
The robots could spin and throw handkerchiefs because they had 19 joints and some extra motors in their arms.
These robots were named "Fu Xi".

filled_text_cn: 在2025年的春节联欢晚会上，一群活泼的人形机器人穿着色彩鲜艳的花夹克，戴着红手帕，用秧歌吸引了观众的目光。
这个节目被称为“YanBOT”。
它由张艺谋导演。
节目中有来自新疆艺术学院的16名机器人和16名舞蹈演员。
这些机器人被命名为H1。
它们拥有许多先进的技术。
例如，高精度3D激光SLAM、自主定位与导航、多智能体协同规划、先进的网络解决方案以及全身AI运动控制。
由于这些技术，机器人可以稳定地移动，并一起做同样的舞蹈动作。
机器人还可以“识别”音乐，并迅速改变动作以跟上节奏。
这些机器人被设计成骨架的样子，而且它们没有裤子。
这是为了与人类舞者形成巨大的差异。
机器人可以旋转和扔手帕，因为它们的关节有19个，手臂上有一些额外的马达。
这些机器人被命名为“伏羲”。
这意味着传统文化和新技术的结合。

questions.explanation: 根据时间状语“In the 2025 Spring Festival Gala”可知动作发生在过去，应用一般过去时。catch的过去式为caught。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时表示在过去某个时间发生的动作或存在的状态，动词用过去式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 空后有名词短语“Yangko dance”，此处需要用形容词性物主代词修饰名词。they的形容词性物主代词为their。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰空后名词用形容词性物主代词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 主语It（节目）与动词direct之间是被动关系，且动作发生在过去，应用一般过去时的被动语态（was/were + done）。主语是It，be动词用was，direct的过去分词为directed。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者时，谓语动词使用被动语态（be + done）。

questions.explanation: technology作“技术”讲时是可数名词，由空前的“many”修饰，因此应用复数形式technologies。
questions.rule_summary: 当名词前有many修饰时，可数名词要用复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: because后接句子，而because of后接名词短语或代词。句中“these technologies”是名词短语，故用because of。
questions.rule_summary: because of意为“因为……”，后接名词、代词或名词短语作宾语。

questions.explanation: 固定短语“the same”意为“相同的”，same前通常要加定冠词the。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“相同的”时，same前通常用定冠词the。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词短语“change their moves”，应用副词形式。quick的副词为quickly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或副词，形容词变副词通常在词尾加-ly。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句型be designed to do sth.意为“被设计用来做某事”，此处用动词不定式作目的状语。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式（to do）常用来作目的状语，表示“为了……”。

questions.explanation: 前后句之间构成因果关系，“它们有19个关节”是机器人可以旋转和扔手帕的原因，应用because引导原因状语从句。
questions.rule_summary: because引导原因状语从句，说明动作发生的原因。

questions.explanation: 空后有名词“culture”，此处需要用形容词来修饰名词。tradition的形容词形式为traditional。
questions.rule_summary: 名词可以通过加后缀派生出形容词来修饰名词。

sections.title: 人与社会 - Passage 14
raw_text: Xi'an is the capital city of Shaanxi province.

questions.explanation: 句意为“西安是一个不断自我改造的城市”，remake oneself 表示“重塑自我”，主语是 Xi'an，应用反身代词 itself。故填 itself。

filled_text: Milk Tea Meets TCM
The old saying "good medicine tastes bitter" may no longer be true in China.
Feeling tired, a 20-year-old college student named Xi Linjie went to a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) hospital in Chongqing.
To her surprise, she got a cup of sweet milk tea instead of medicine.

With the help of modern technology, the hospital makes the tea taste better.
For example, they use rose oil instead of rose petals to make it less bitter.
Besides, the hospital also tries to make candies, cakes
and other products with TCM.
"Our goal is to help people prevent and cure diseases while they are enjoying delicious food and drinks," Liao explained.
In Chongqing, there is also a TCM night market, which is held every weekend.
People can easily get health service there.
"TCM is much closer to our daily lives than before."
A man said.
Over half of the visitors are young people who come to ask for professional advice.
It shows that the younger ones are more and more confident of TCM nowadays.
filled_text_cn: 奶茶遇上中医

20岁的大学生席琳捷感到疲惫，便去了重庆的一家中医医院。
令她惊讶的是，她得到了一杯甜奶茶而不是药品。
这杯茶既美味又健康。
这杯特殊的奶茶是由医院营养部门制作的。
他们将传统中药与现代食品融合在一起。
“奶茶在年轻人中很受欢迎。
我们希望它能成为一座桥梁，让他们增加对中医的了解并接受中医，”该团队负责人廖长颖说道。
她表示，几乎每个人都想在尝试奶茶后与亲友分享这种特殊体验。
在现代技术的帮助下，医院改善了茶的口味。
例如，他们用玫瑰油代替玫瑰花瓣来降低苦味。
除此之外，医院还尝试制作糖果、蛋糕
和其他含中药的产品。
“我们的目标是帮助人们在享受美食和饮料时预防治疗疾病，”廖解释说。
在重庆，还有一个每周末举办的中医夜市。
人们可以在那里轻松获得健康服务。
“中医比以前更贴近我们的生活。”
一位男士说道。
超过一半的来寻求专业建议的来访者是年轻人。
这表明现在的年轻人对中医越来越自信了。

questions.explanation: 根据“went...was...”可知，此处描述过去发生的事情，需用一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式。故填 got。
questions.rule_summary: 根据上下文的时间状语或前后句的时态一致性，判断并使用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 根据“a cup of sweet milk tea”可知，空处指前文提到的那杯奶茶，需定冠词 the，放句首时，首字母大写。故填 The。
questions.rule_summary: 特指前文提到过的人或物时，用定冠词 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 根据“This special milk tea”和“make”可知，此处两者构成逻辑上的动宾关系，名词在句首做主语，因此此处应用一般现在时的被动语态，对应的结构是 be done，主语为不可数名词，be动词用is。故填 is made。
questions.rule_summary: 当主语是动作的承受者时，应用被动语态（be done）。

questions.explanation: would like to do sth.固定搭配，表示“想要做某事”，故空处需动词不定式。故填 to share。
questions.rule_summary: 固定搭配 would like to do sth. 中需用动词不定式作宾语。

questions.explanation: with the help of 固定搭配，表示“在......帮助下”，放句首时，首字母大写。故填 With。
questions.rule_summary: 熟记常见介词固定搭配，如 with the help of (在……帮助下)。

questions.explanation: 连接并列成分 candies 和 cakes，需连词 and。故填 and。
questions.rule_summary: 连接并列的单词或短语表顺承关系时，通常用并列连词 and。

questions.explanation: 根据“goal is...”可知，空处需形容词性物主代词来修饰名词 goal，we为主格，其形容词性物主代词为our，放句首时，首字母大写。故填 Our。

questions.explanation: 根据“than”可知，空处需用比较级。故填 closer。

questions.explanation: 根据“are young people”可知，此处主语应当是人，且是名词复数。故填 visitors。

questions.explanation: 句意：我们中国人从2000多年前就开始过春节了。根据“since more than 2,000 years ago”可知，动作从过去持续到现在，需用现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）。主语“We Chinese”为复数，故填 have celebrated。

questions.explanation: 句意：但第三个（烟花）有时更危险。根据“three Fs”可知，此处指第三个，需用序数词 third 表示顺序。
questions.rule_summary: 表示顺序时基数词需转换为对应的序数词，并在前面加定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: 句意：我想就如何保护自己免受烟花伤害给出建议。主语“we”与宾语为同一对象，需用反身代词 ourselves“我们自己”。

questions.explanation: 句意：相反，站在几米外，迅速用水浇湿它。根据“a few”可知，其后接可数名词复数，meter 需变为 meters。
questions.rule_summary: a few 修饰可数名词复数。

questions.explanation: 句意：你站得越远越好。“the + 比较级 + 主谓，the + 比较级 + 主谓”结构表示“越……越……”。far 的比较级为 farther 或 further。

让我们动起来吧。
你的身体会为此感谢你的！

questions.explanation: 句意：零食式锻炼成为想要保持健康的人们的一种流行新方式。根据“popular new way”可知，此处需要不定冠词表示“一种”，popular以辅音音素开头，故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词泛指时，辅音音素前用a，元音音素前用an。

questions.explanation: 句意：而不是花几个小时在操场上，这种“大型锻炼餐”被他们分成小的“零食”。根据“by them”可知，此处是被动语态结构，句子是一般现在时，主语是单数，be动词用is，故填 is broken。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者时，谓语动词需用“be + 过去分词”的被动语态结构。

questions.explanation: 句意：然后你可以休息30分钟到4个小时，再决定进行下一次零食式锻炼。decide to do sth“决定做某事”，后接不定式作宾语，故填 to take。
questions.rule_summary: decide等动词后常接动词不定式（to do）作宾语。

questions.explanation: 句意：除此之外，还有许多其他好处。根据“lots of”可知，此处修饰可数名词复数，故填 benefits。
questions.rule_summary: lots of / many 等修饰可数名词时，名词应用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：你的专注力会变得更好，思维也会更有创造力。and连接并列结构，且与“better”对应，需用比较级，故填 more creative。
questions.rule_summary: 并列句式中前后结构或程度应保持一致，多音节形容词比较级前加more。

questions.explanation: 句意：有很多可接受的零食式锻炼，比如仰卧起坐、跳绳或上下楼梯跑步。根据“doing sit-ups, jumping rope or running up and down some stairs.”可知，此处表示列举，应用介词like。
questions.rule_summary: like常用于列举具体的事物或例子，意为“例如，像”。

questions.explanation: 句意：如果你不知道从哪里开始，这里有一些有用的锻炼选择：根据上下文可知，此处是条件状语从句，应用if引导，故填 If。
questions.rule_summary: 表示假设或条件的状语从句常用if引导。

questions.explanation: 句意：因为大多数人不会在办公室放哑铃，所以可以举装满水的瓶子。根据“offices”可知，此处需用形容词性物主代词作定语，故填 their。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰空后的名词需用形容词性物主代词。

questions.explanation: 句意：只需调大音乐音量，选择一首欢快的歌曲，开始跳舞。根据句子结构可知，此处需用副词修饰动词turn up，故填 Simply。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或整个句子。

questions.explanation: 句意：它会很快让你感到放松。根据上下文语境可知，此处描述未来的动作，应用一般将来时，表示“将会感到放松”，故填 will make。
questions.rule_summary: 根据语境表示将要发生的动作或状态时，谓语动词常用一般将来时（will do）。

sections.title: 人与自我 - Passage 4
raw_text: Have you ever heard of the saying "Don't judge a book by its cover"?
Well, in Chinese, we 171. ________ (actual) have an expression called "yi mao qu ren".
Imagine you meet someone new at school.
They might look different 172. ________ you in hair, clothes, or looks.
It is important 173. ________ (avoid) making any judgments about them just because of how they look.
Sometimes, people make 174. ________ mistake by judging others by their looks.
They might think someone isn't 175. ________ (friend) just because they have a serious face or wear unusual clothes.
But what meets the eye isn't always the 176. ________ (true)!
Think about your best friends.
When you met them at early time, you might not have known they would become your best friends.
177. ________ as you spent time together and got to know each other, you realized how amazing they were.
By not judging people by their looks, we open our hearts to new people in our lives.
We start to understand the differences between 178. ________ (we), like different cultures, backgrounds, and ways of thinking.
So, let's keep an open mind and be nice to everyone we meet.
Let's treat others with kindness and fairness, no matter how they look.
When we do that, we make a world where everyone 179. ________ (feel) important.
After all, the most amazing things 180. ________ (hide) within every one of us!
filled_text: Have you ever heard of the saying "Don't judge a book by its cover"?
Well, in Chinese, we actually have an expression called "yi mao qu ren".
Imagine you meet someone new at school.
They might look different from you in hair, clothes, or looks.
It is important to avoid making any judgments about them just because of how they look.
Sometimes, people make a mistake by judging others by their looks.
They might think someone isn't friendly just because they have a serious face or wear unusual clothes.
But what meets the eye isn't always the truth!
Think about your best friends.
When you met them at early time, you might not have known they would become your best friends.
But as you spent time together and got to know each other, you realized how amazing they were.
By not judging people by their looks, we open our hearts to new people in our lives.
We start to understand the differences between ourselves, like different cultures, backgrounds, and ways of thinking.
So, let's keep an open mind and be nice to everyone we meet.
Let's treat others with kindness and fairness, no matter how they look.
When we do that, we make a world where everyone feels important.
After all, the most amazing things are hidden within every one of us!
filled_text_cn: 你听说过“不要以貌取人”这句谚语吗？
嗯，在中文里，我们实际上有一个表达叫“以貌取人”。
想象你在学校遇到一个新同学。
他们在发型、衣着或长相上可能与你不同。
避免仅仅因为他们的外表而对他们做出任何判断是很重要的。
有时，人们会犯通过外表评判他人的错误。
他们可能仅仅因为某人表情严肃或穿着不寻常的衣服，就认为这个人不友好。
但眼见未必为实！
想想你的好朋友们。
当你们最初相遇时，你可能并不知道他们会成为你的至交好友。
但是当你们一起度过时光并逐渐了解彼此后，你意识到他们有多棒。
通过不以貌取人，我们向生活中的新朋友敞开了心扉。
我们开始理解我们自身之间的差异，比如不同的文化、背景和思维方式。
所以，让我们保持开放的心态，对遇到的每个人都友善。
让我们以善良和公平对待他人，无论他们看起来如何。
当我们这样做时，我们创造了一个让每个人都感到自己很重要的世界。
毕竟，最令人惊奇的东西隐藏在我们每个人身上！

questions.explanation: 句意：嗯，在中文里，我们实际上有一个表达叫“以貌取人”。根据“we... (actual) have an expression”可知，这里需要一个副词修饰动词“have”。“actual”的副词形式是“actually”，表示“实际上”。故填 actually。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或整个句子。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：他们可能在发型、衣着或长相上与你不同。“be different from”是固定搭配，意为“与……不同”。故填 from。
questions.rule_summary: 固定搭配 be different from 意为“与……不同”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：避免根据他们的长相做出任何判断是很重要的。根据“It is important... (avoid) making any judgments”可知，此处为“It is+形容词+ to do sth.”的固定句型，意为“做某事是……的”。故填 to avoid。
questions.rule_summary: 句型 It is + adj. + to do sth. 中用动词不定式作真正的主语。

questions.explanation: 句意：有时，人们会犯一个通过外貌评判他人的错误。“make a mistake”是固定短语，意为“犯一个错误”。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 固定短语 make a mistake 中使用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 句意：他们可能仅仅因为某人表情严肃或穿着不寻常的衣服，就认为这个人不友好。根据“isn't”可知，这里需要一个形容词作表语。“friend”的形容词形式是“friendly”，表示“友好的”。故填 friendly。
questions.rule_summary: be 动词后面常接形容词作表语。

questions.explanation: 句意：但眼见未必为实！根据“the”可知，这里需要一个名词。“true”的名词形式是“truth”，表示“事实；真相”。故填 truth。
questions.rule_summary: 定冠词 the 后面通常接名词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and / but / or / so)
questions.explanation: 句意：但是当你们一起度过时光并逐渐了解彼此后，你意识到他们有多棒。根据前文“you might not have known they would become your best friends”和后文“you realized how amazing they were”可知，这里存在转折关系。“But”表示“但是”，表转折。故填 But。
questions.rule_summary: 前后文语意存在转折时，应用转折连词 but。

questions.explanation: 句意：我们开始了解我们自身之间的差异，比如不同的文化、背景和思维方式。根据“We start to understand the differences between”可知，这里需要一个反身代词。“we”的反身代词是“ourselves”，表示“我们自己”。故填 ourselves。
questions.rule_summary: 表达主语自身时使用反身代词。

questions.explanation: 句意：当我们这样做时，我们创造了一个让每个人都感到自己很重要的世界。根据“everyone”是不定代词，作主语时，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式。“feel”的第三人称单数形式是“feels”。故填 feels。
questions.rule_summary: 不定代词 everyone 作主语时，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：毕竟，最令人惊奇的东西隐藏在我们每个人身上！根据“the most amazing things”和“hide”之间是被动关系，即“东西被隐藏”，且句子是一般现在时，所以用一般现在时的被动语态“am/is/are + 过去分词”。“hide”的过去分词是“hidden”，“things”是复数，所以用“are hidden”。故填 are hidden。
questions.rule_summary: 主语与动词构成被动关系且为客观事实时，应用一般现在时的被动语态。

sections.title: 人与自我 - Passage 5
raw_text: Long ago, people did not use money.
Instead, people traded one thing for another thing.
A chicken, for example, was traded for something else that had value.
181. ________ the value was the problem.
One chicken did not have the value of one cow.
182. ________ world needed something that would have the same value everywhere.
That something was gold.
At the beginning, gold was used 183. ________ (trade).
To be used for trade, the gold had to be checked to see if it was real gold.
It was a lot of trouble.
Then, around 700 BC, gold was made into coins.
It became a lot 184. ________ (easy) to buy things with coins that could be counted.
It was not until the 1700s that the 185. ________ (one) paper money was made.
Paper money brought a new problem, though.
If a country printed a lot of money, the money would lose 186. ________ (it) value.
Paper money needed to be tied to something of value.
Again, that thing was gold.
In 1821, England introduced the gold standard.
That meant that paper money was 187. ________ (support) by gold.
Paper money could be traded for gold in an equal value.
Most large 188. ________ (country) followed England in using the gold standard.
After World War I, the world economy was not good.
Also, new gold was not found fast enough.
Economic problems appeared again.
Soon, people stopped using the gold standard.
They began to base their money on the value of the 189. ________ (Britain) pound or American dollar.
The gold standard worked fine 190. ________ the past.
But times change, and the gold standard is now just history.
filled_text: Long ago, people did not use money.
Instead, people traded one thing for another thing.
A chicken, for example, was traded for something else that had value.
But the value was the problem.
One chicken did not have the value of one cow.
The world needed something that would have the same value everywhere.
That something was gold.
At the beginning, gold was used for trade.
To be used for trade, the gold had to be checked to see if it was real gold.
It was a lot of trouble.
Then, around 700 BC, gold was made into coins.
It became a lot easier to buy things with coins that could be counted.
It was not until the 1700s that the first paper money was made.
Paper money brought a new problem, though.
If a country printed a lot of money, the money would lose its value.
Paper money needed to be tied to something of value.
Again, that thing was gold.
In 1821, England introduced the gold standard.
That meant that paper money was supported by gold.
Paper money could be traded for gold in an equal value.
Most large countries followed England in using the gold standard.
After World War I, the world economy was not good.
Also, new gold was not found fast enough.
Economic problems appeared again.
Soon, people stopped using the gold standard.
They began to base their money on the value of the British pound or American dollar.
The gold standard worked fine in the past.
But times change, and the gold standard is now just history.
filled_text_cn: 很久以前，人们不用钱。
相反，人们用一样东西去交换另一样东西。
例如，一只鸡可以用来交换有价值的其他东西。
但是价值才是问题所在。
一只鸡没有一头牛的价值。
世界需要某种在任何地方都有相同价值的东西。
那个东西就是黄金。
一开始，黄金被用来进行交易。
为了用于交易，必须检查黄金以看它是否是真金。
这带来了很多麻烦。
然后，大约在公元前700年，黄金被制成了硬币。
用可以数出来的硬币买东西变得容易多了。
直到18世纪，第一张纸币才被制造出来。
然而，纸币带来了新的问题。
如果一个国家印了很多钱，这些钱就会失去它的价值。
纸币需要与有价值的东西挂钩。
同样，那个东西是黄金。
1821年，英国引入了金本位制。
这意味着纸币是由黄金支撑的。
纸币可以等值兑换黄金。
大多数大国都在效仿英国采用金本位制。
第一次世界大战后，世界经济并不好。
而且，新黄金的发现速度不够快。
经济问题再次出现。
很快，人们停止使用金本位制。
他们开始以英镑或美元的价值为基础来确定货币价值。
金本位制在过去运行良好。
但时代在变，金本位制现在已成历史。

questions.explanation: 句意：但是价值才是问题所在。“One chicken did not have the value of one cow.”与“A chicken, for example, was traded for something else that had value.”构成转折关系，but“但是”，连词，句首首字母大写。故填 But。
questions.rule_summary: 根据前后句的逻辑关系（如转折、因果、并列）选择正确的连词。

questions.explanation: 句意：世界需要某种在任何地方都有相同价值的东西。world为独一无二的事物，其前需加定冠词 the，句首首字母大写。故填 The。
questions.rule_summary: 独一无二的事物或特指名词前通常用定冠词 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：一开始，黄金被用来进行交易。be used for sth.“被用来做某事”。故填 for trade。
questions.rule_summary: 熟练掌握常用动介/形介固定搭配及基本用法。

questions.explanation: 句意：用可以数出来的硬币买东西变得容易多了。本句表达用硬币买东西比以前硬币没出现时更容易，结合“a lot”修饰形容词比较级，所以此处填写 easy 的比较级。故填 easier。
questions.rule_summary: 当有 a lot、much、even 等词修饰时，形容词/副词通常用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：直到18世纪，第一张纸币才被制造出来。根据 the 及语境可知，此处表达“第一”张纸币，填写 one 的序数词表示顺序。故填 first。
questions.rule_summary: 当基数词前有 the 等限定词，且表示顺序时，需变为序数词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 句意：如果一个国家印了很多钱，这些钱就会失去它的价值。设空处修饰其后名词 value，所以填写 it 的形容词性物主代词。故填 its。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词时用形容词性物主代词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：这意味着纸币是由黄金支撑的。主语“paper money”与 support 之间是逻辑上的动宾关系，结合 meant，此处应用一般过去时的被动语态表达，主语为不可数名词，be 动词用 was。故填 was supported。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者时，根据时态使用相应的被动语态结构 (be + done)。

questions.explanation: 句意：大多数大国都在效仿英国采用金本位制。country“国家”，most 后接可数名词复数。故填 countries。
questions.rule_summary: most 等词修饰可数名词时，名词通常用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：他们开始以英镑或美元的价值为基础。British pound“英镑”，专有名词或形容词修饰名词。故填 British。
questions.rule_summary: 名词可派生出形容词来修饰其后的名词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：金本位制在过去运行良好。in the past“在过去”，介词短语。故填 in。
questions.rule_summary: 牢记常用介词固定短语搭配（如 in the past）。

sections.title: 人与自我 - Passage 6
raw_text: Having zaocha, or morning tea, is a traditional morning activity for people in Guangdong.
Whether rich or poor, young or old, local people go to morning tea houses 191. ________ (drink) tea or enjoy dim sum for breakfast.
For 192. ________ (they), having zaocha is not just a daily habit but also an important way of social communication.
Guangdong morning tea can go back to the Qing Dynasty.
It began 193. ________ a small restaurant in Guangzhou called "Yi Li Guan", where tea and dim sum 194. ________ (serve).
Over time, more and more similar tea houses appeared, and since then, Cantonese people 195. ________ (develop) the habit of drinking morning tea in tea houses.
Today, on weekends or holidays, the whole family or good friends often get together for morning tea.
It is seen as an enjoyable way to pass time and relax 196. ________ (complete).
In morning tea, tea is a necessary part.
The Cantonese prefer black tea because it warms the stomach 197. ________ helps digestion.
Although it's a little bitter and 198. ________ (little) clear than green tea, it pairs perfectly with dim sum during morning tea.
Oolong tea, Tieguanyin tea and Pu'er tea are also popular 199. ________ (choice).
The morning tea culture is not only popular in Guangdong, but has also become a global trend, thanks to 200. ________ increasing number of overseas Chinese.
Guangdong morning tea restaurants can now be found easily in big cities like New York and even on some small islands in the South Pacific Ocean.
filled_text: Having zaocha, or morning tea, is a traditional morning activity for people in Guangdong.
Whether rich or poor, young or old, local people go to morning tea houses to drink tea or enjoy dim sum for breakfast.
For them, having zaocha is not just a daily habit but also an important way of social communication.
Guangdong morning tea can go back to the Qing Dynasty.
It began in a small restaurant in Guangzhou called "Yi Li Guan", where tea and dim sum were served.
Over time, more and more similar tea houses appeared, and since then, Cantonese people have developed the habit of drinking morning tea in tea houses.
Today, on weekends or holidays, the whole family or good friends often get together for morning tea.
It is seen as an enjoyable way to pass time and relax completely.
In morning tea, tea is a necessary part.
The Cantonese prefer black tea because it warms the stomach and helps digestion.
Although it's a little bitter and less clear than green tea, it pairs perfectly with dim sum during morning tea.
Oolong tea, Tieguanyin tea and Pu'er tea are also popular choices.
The morning tea culture is not only popular in Guangdong, but has also become a global trend, thanks to the increasing number of overseas Chinese.
Guangdong morning tea restaurants can now be found easily in big cities like New York and even on some small islands in the South Pacific Ocean.
filled_text_cn: 喝早茶是广东人传统的早晨活动。
无论贫穷还是富有，年轻还是年长，当地人都会去早茶馆喝茶或享用点心作为早餐。
对他们来说，喝早茶不仅是一种日常习惯，也是社交的重要方式。
广东早茶可以追溯到清朝。
它始于广州一家名为“一里馆”的小餐馆，在那里提供茶和点心。
随着时间的推移，越来越多类似的茶馆出现了，从那时起，广州人养成了在茶馆喝早茶的习惯。
今天，在周末或节假日，全家人或好朋友经常聚在一起喝早茶。
它被视为一种令人愉快的打发时间和完全放松的方式。
在早茶中，茶是必不可少的一部分。
广东人更喜欢红茶，因为它能暖胃并且有助于消化。
虽然它有点苦，并且不如绿茶清澈，但它与早茶时的点心完美搭配。
乌龙茶、铁观音茶和普洱茶也是受欢迎的选择。
由于越来越多的海外华人，早茶文化不仅在广东流行，而且已经成为一种全球趋势。
现在，在纽约这样的大城市，甚至在南太平洋的一些小岛上，都能轻易找到广东早茶餐厅。

questions.explanation: 去早茶馆的目的是喝茶或享用点心，此处应用动词不定式作目的状语。
questions.rule_summary: 表示目的时通常使用动词不定式 (to do)。

questions.explanation: for 是介词，介词后面需接人称代词的宾格形式作宾语，they 的宾格形式是 them。
questions.rule_summary: 介词后面使用人称代词的宾格形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 表示“在某个较大的地点/餐馆内部”时用介词 in。
questions.rule_summary: 表示在空间内部或某个城市等范围时用介词 in。

questions.explanation: tea and dim sum 是动作 serve 的承受者，二者构成被动关系；描述过去的事情用一般过去时的被动语态，主语是复数，故填 were served。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作承受者且发生在过去时，用一般过去时的被动语态 (was/were done)。

questions.explanation: 根据 since then（从那时起）可知，此句时态应用现在完成时 (have/has + done)，主语 Cantonese people 是复数，助动词用 have。
questions.rule_summary: 标志词 since then 通常与现在完成时连用。

questions.explanation: 此处需要用副词来修饰动词 relax，complete 的副词形式是 completely。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词、形容词或其他副词。

questions.explanation: it warms the stomach 与 helps digestion 是并列的顺承关系，应用并列连词 and 连接。
questions.rule_summary: 表示同向并列或顺承关系时使用 and。

questions.explanation: 根据后文的 than 可知，此处应用比较级，little 的比较级是 less。
questions.rule_summary: 句中出现 than 时，形容词或副词通常用比较级形式。

questions.explanation: 句中列举了乌龙茶、铁观音和普洱茶多种茶，主语是复数概念，故 choice 应用复数形式 choices。
questions.rule_summary: 当指代多项事物或名词作表语与复数主语保持一致时，可数名词用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 固定短语 the increasing number of 表示“越来越多的……”，故填定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: 固定结构 the number of / the increasing number of 前需加定冠词 the。

filled_text: As a university student, I decided to learn German.
For some reason, I really liked the language, but I was not very good at learning it.
The grammar nearly drove me crazy.
My only advantage was that I got an A on every word test.
After two years of study, I decided to study in Germany.
It was the hardest term I would ever have.
When I arrived in Germany, I found the German I learned in university wasn't useful at all for daily conversation.
