filled_text_cn: 作为一名大学生，我决定学习德语。
出于某种原因，我真的很喜欢这门语言，但我并不太擅长学习它。
语法几乎把我逼疯了。
我唯一的优势是我每次单词测试都得A。
经过两年的学习，我决定去德国留学。
那是我经历过的最难的一个学期。
当我到达德国时，我发现我在大学里学的德语对日常对话一点也没用。
我在学校里经常感到紧张，因为我总是担心老师会在课堂上点名叫我。
我在室友中间才稍微放松了一点，因为他们愿意慢慢地跟我说德语，而且似乎不介意我的错误。
我选择了三门课程——读写、语法和历史。
这些课程都是德语授课而且很难，但历史课是最糟糕的。
老师语速太快，他讲的内容几乎我都听不懂。
我坐在前排，做笔记，甚至仔细记下了他说的每一个字，但都于事无补。
我根本不知道这节课到底讲的是什么。
多年过去了，我仍然记得学习另一门语言的感觉。
那次经历是一个艰难但有价值的教训。
我认为那个学期的失败和成功一样教给了我很多东西。

questions.explanation: 根据上下文语境，描述过去发生的事情应用一般过去时。drive sb. crazy 是固定搭配，意为“使某人发疯”，所给词 drive 的过去式为 drove。故选 drove。
questions.rule_summary: 谓语动词在描述过去发生的动作或状态时使用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 句意：我唯一的优势是我每次单词测试都得A。分析句子结构可知，was后面是表语从句，从句“I got an A on every word test”句意完整且不缺成分，应用that引导表语从句。故选 that。
questions.rule_summary: 表语从句意思完整、不缺少成分时，通常用that引导且不可省略。

questions.explanation: 根据句前的定冠词the以及句意“那是我经历过的最难的学期”可知，此处表示三者或三者以上的最高程度，应用形容词最高级 hardest。故选 hardest。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词最高级前通常加the，用于表示在范围内“最……”的含义。

questions.explanation: 根据句意“我发现大学里学的德语对日常对话一点也没用”可知，此处应用use的形容词形式useful（有用的），构成 wasn't useful 结构。故选 useful。
questions.rule_summary: 动词可以通过添加后缀派生成形容词，在句中作表语修饰主语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：我在学校里经常感到紧张，因为我总是担心老师会在课堂上点名叫我。worried about 意为“担心”，符合语境。故选 worried about。
questions.rule_summary: 熟记常用动词短语及介词搭配（如 worry about 意为“担心”）。

questions.explanation: 根据上下文语境，故事发生在过去，应用一般过去时。结合“室友愿意慢慢说德语且不介意错误”可知，作者在他们中间感到放松了，relax的过去式为 relaxed。故选 relaxed。
questions.rule_summary: 讲述过去发生的动作时，谓语动词需使用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 句意：……似乎不介意我的错误。mistake 为可数名词，此处泛指学习语言过程中犯的各种错误，应用复数形式 mistakes。故选 mistakes。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词在泛指或无特指限定词修饰且表复数概念时应用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词短语“wrote down”应用副词。careful 的副词形式为 carefully（仔细地），符合“写下每一个字”的语境。故选 carefully。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词转换成副词（通常加 -ly）用来修饰动词、形容词或整个句子。

questions.explanation: 句意：多年过去了，我仍然记得学习另一种语言的感觉。feel to do sth. 或固定句型中不定式作后置定语，此处表示学习语言，应用动词原形 learn。故选 learn。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式（to do）可在名词或特定结构后作定语或宾语补足语。

questions.explanation: 句意：那次经历是一个艰难但有价值的教训。由连词 but 连接的并列形容词，difficult 是形容词，此处也需要填形容词。value 的形容词形式为 valuable（有价值的）。故选 valuable。
questions.rule_summary: 名词或动词可以通过添加后缀派生出形容词，在句中作定语或表语。

sections.title: 人与自我 - Passage 8
raw_text: From careless to careful
A top student shares tips on how to down careless mistakes.
(Li Zhifei, 20, graduated from The High School Affiliated; Major in Computer Science Renmin University of China)
Careless mistakes used 211. ________ (bother) me.
I often thought they were just about "not being careful".
But as time went by, I learned that these mistakes can show how we think.
To rise above them, we need to change how we solve problems.
212. ________ (one) of all, I come to understand that everyone makes mistakes; it is simply a part of being human.
Accepting this cuts down my stress and helps me get better.
Later, I decide to keep a diary of my mistakes.
I mark down what I did wrong and sort out my mistakes 213. ________ (careful), like misreading or miscalculating.
This helps me learn 214. ________ my mistakes.
Next, I make checklists for things to do for different 215. ________ (subject).
For math, there are steps like checking answers and calculations.
For writing, I review the paper and do a grammar check.
These checklists serve as 216. ________ (I) guides, helping me with my work.
Besides, taking breaks is important too.
Whenever I feel worried, I take a deep breath, rethink my methods and slow down my thinking.
Then, the mistakes will 217. ________ (catch) before they happen.

filled_text: From careless to careful
A top student shares tips on how to down careless mistakes.
(Li Zhifei, 20, graduated from The High School Affiliated; Major in Computer Science Renmin University of China)
Careless mistakes used to bother me.
I often thought they were just about "not being careful".
But as time went by, I learned that these mistakes can show how we think.
To rise above them, we need to change how we solve problems.
First of all, I come to understand that everyone makes mistakes; it is simply a part of being human.
Accepting this cuts down my stress and helps me get better.
Later, I decide to keep a diary of my mistakes.
I mark down what I did wrong and sort out my mistakes carefully, like misreading or miscalculating.
This helps me learn from my mistakes.
Next, I make checklists for things to do for different subjects.
For math, there are steps like checking answers and calculations.
For writing, I review the paper and do a grammar check.
These checklists serve as my guides, helping me with my work.
Besides, taking breaks is important too.
Whenever I feel worried, I take a deep breath, rethink my methods and slow down my thinking.
Then, the mistakes will be caught before they happen.
What's more, I celebrate my improvement, no matter how small it is.
This practice not only makes me feel confident, but also helps me improve.
Through these efforts, I'm sure I will make great success in the future.
filled_text_cn: 从粗心到细心
一位优秀学生分享了关于如何减少粗心错误的建议。
(李之飞，20岁，毕业于人大附中；主修中国人民大学计算机科学专业)
粗心的错误过去常常困扰我。
我经常认为它们只是“不够小心”的问题。
但随着时间的推移，我了解到这些错误可以展示我们的思维方式。
为了克服它们，我们需要改变解决问题的方式。
首先，我开始明白每个人都会犯错，这是人之常情。
接受这一点减轻了我的压力，并帮助我变得更好。
后来，我决定写错题日记。
我记下自己做错的事情，并仔细地整理错误，比如看错或算错。
这帮助我从错误中吸取教训。
接下来，我为不同的科目制作待办事项清单。
对于数学，有检查答案和计算等步骤。
对于写作，我复习试卷并进行语法检查。
这些清单作为我的指南，帮助我完成工作。
此外，适当休息也很重要。
每当感到焦虑时，我都会深呼吸，重新思考我的方法并放慢思维。
然后，这些错误就会在发生之前被发现。
而且，无论进步多么小，我都会庆祝。
这种做法不仅让我感到自信，还帮助我提高。
通过这些努力，我相信我将来一定会取得巨大的成功。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：粗心的错误过去常常困扰我。根据“used”可知，此处考查固定搭配“used to do sth.”，表示“过去常常做某事”。所以这里要用动词不定式“to bother”。
questions.rule_summary: used to do sth. 表示过去常常做某事。

questions.explanation: 句意：首先，我开始明白每个人都会犯错，这是人之常情。根据“of all”可知，这里考查固定短语“first of all”，表示“首先”，用于引出一系列事物或理由中的第一个。
questions.rule_summary: first of all 表示首先。

questions.explanation: 句意：我把做错的事情记录下来，并仔细地整理我的错误，比如看错或算错。根据“sort out my mistakes”可知，这里需要一个副词来修饰动词短语“sort out”，表示“仔细地”。“careful”的副词形式是“carefully”。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰动词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：这帮助我从错误中学习。根据“learn”和“my mistakes”可知，此处考查固定搭配“learn from”，表示“从......中学到”。
questions.rule_summary: learn from 意为从……中学习。

questions.explanation: 句意：接下来，我为不同的科目制作待办事项清单。根据“different”可知，后面接可数名词复数形式，表示多个不同的事物。“subject”是可数名词，其复数形式是“subjects”。
questions.rule_summary: different 后接可数名词复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 句意：这些清单作为我的指南，帮助我完成工作。根据“guides”可知，这里需要一个形容词性物主代词来修饰名词，表示所属关系。“I”的形容词性物主代词是“my”，意为“我的”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词用形容词性物主代词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：然后，这些错误会在发生之前被发现。根据“the mistakes”和“catch”的关系可知，错误是被发现，要用被动语态。“will”是一般将来时的助动词，其被动语态结构是“will+be+过去分词”，“catch”的过去分词是“caught”。
questions.rule_summary: 情态动词/助动词后接 be done 构成被动语态。

questions.explanation: 句意：此外，无论进步多么小，我都会庆祝。根据“no matter”和“small”可知，这里考查“no matter how+形容词/副词”引导让步状语从句，表示“无论多么......”。
questions.rule_summary: no matter how + 形容词/副词引导让步状语从句。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词派生名词/名词派生形容词
questions.explanation: 句意：这种做法不仅让我感到自信，还帮助我提高。根据“feel”可知，这是一个系动词，后面接形容词作表语。“confidence”是名词，其形容词形式是“confident”，表示“自信的”。
questions.rule_summary: 系动词 feel 后常接形容词作表语。

questions.explanation: 句意：通过这些努力，我相信我将来会取得巨大的成功。根据“in the future”可知，这里表示将来会发生的动作，要用一般将来时，其结构是“will+动词原形”。
questions.rule_summary: in the future 是标志词，通常与一般将来时连用。

sections.title: 人与自我 - Passage 9
raw_text: From ancient times to today, poets have been seen as romantic, well-educated and full of feelings.
Can you imagine that a miner, born 221. ________ a mountain village with only a high school diploma, doing the 222. ________ (hard) and most dangerous work in a mine, could write moving poems?
Chen Nianxi has been living a literary dream for most of his life.
Chen was born in the mountains of Shaanxi.
Inspired by newspapers and literary journals, Chen wrote his 223. ________ (one) poem in high school.
After high school, Chen farmed and got married.
224. ________ (make) a living for the whole family, he took up mining because the job 225. ________ (pay) quite well.
For more than 15 years, he worked hard during the day, while reading and writing poems at night.
Accidents took the 226. ________ (life) of several other miners, as well as the hearing in his right ear.
Darkness, fear and loneliness filled his work as 227. ________ miner.
His experience in the mines was the source of inspiration for his poems, making him stand out in modern Chinese literature.
He 228. ________ (publish) several well-received books so far.
229. ________ Chen has a hard life, his poetry has a feeling of hope and strength.
He hopes that his work will help modern people open 230. ________ (they) minds and remind them to look downward sometimes.
filled_text: From ancient times to today, poets have been seen as romantic, well-educated and full of feelings.
Can you imagine that a miner, born in a mountain village with only a high school diploma, doing the hardest and most dangerous work in a mine, could write moving poems?
Chen Nianxi has been living a literary dream for most of his life.
Chen was born in the mountains of Shaanxi.
Inspired by newspapers and literary journals, Chen wrote his first poem in high school.
After high school, Chen farmed and got married.
To make a living for the whole family, he took up mining because the job paid quite well.
For more than 15 years, he worked hard during the day, while reading and writing poems at night.
Accidents took the lives of several other miners, as well as the hearing in his right ear.
Darkness, fear and loneliness filled his work as a miner.
His experience in the mines was the source of inspiration for his poems, making him stand out in modern Chinese literature.
He has published several well-received books so far.
Although Chen has a hard life, his poetry has a feeling of hope and strength.
He hopes that his work will help modern people open their minds and remind them to look downward sometimes.
filled_text_cn: 从古至今，诗人都被视为浪漫、见多识广且充满情感的人。
你能想象一个矿工，出生在一个小山村，只有高中学历，在矿井里从事着最艰苦、最危险的工作，却能写出动人的诗篇吗？
陈年喜大半生都在过着一种文学梦的生活。
陈年喜出生在陕西的山区里。
受报纸和文学期刊的启发，他在高中时写下了自己的第一首诗。
高中毕业后，陈年喜种过地，结过婚。
为了养活全家，他从事采矿工作，因为这份工作报酬丰厚。
在十五年多的时间里，他白天辛勤工作，晚上则阅读和写诗。
矿难夺去了其他几名矿工的生命，也让他右耳失聪。
黑暗、恐惧和孤独充斥着他的矿工生涯。
他在矿井中的经历成为其诗歌灵感来源，使他在中国现代文学中脱颖而出。
迄今为止，他已出版了几部广受好评的著作。
尽管陈年喜生活艰难，但他的诗作却充满希望与力量。
他希望自己的作品能帮助现代人开阔视野，并提醒他们有时也要低头看看。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：你能想象一个矿工，出生在山区的一个小村庄，只有高中学历……根据“born...a mountain village”可知，此处表示“出生在一个小山村”，固定搭配“born in+地点”表示“出生于某地”。此处应用介词in。
questions.rule_summary: 表示出生于某地用固定搭配 born in + 地点。

questions.explanation: 句意：……在矿井里从事着最艰苦、最危险的工作……hard艰难的，形容词；根据“the...and most dangerous”可知，此处需用最高级 hardest，与“most dangerous”并列。
questions.rule_summary: 当形容词与最高级并列修饰同一名词且前有定冠词时，应用最高级形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：受报纸和文学期刊的启发，他在高中时写下了自己的第一首诗。one一，基数词；根据“...poem in high school”及首次创作的语境，此处应用序数词修饰名词 poem，表示“第一首”。
questions.rule_summary: 表达“第几个”时，基数词需转换为对应的序数词。

questions.explanation: 句意：为了养活全家，他从事采矿工作……make a living 谋生；根据“...a living for the whole family, he took up mining”可知，此处应用不定式作目的状语，说明“为了谋生而从事采矿”。
questions.rule_summary: 表示目的时，句首通常使用动词不定式（To do）作目的状语。

questions.explanation: 句意：为了养活全家，他从事采矿工作，因为这份工作报酬丰厚。pay支付，动词；根据“he took up mining because the job...quite well.”可知，这句话用一般过去时描述过去选择采矿的原因，此处动词需用过去式 paid。
questions.rule_summary: 主句为一般过去时，从句若描述当时的情况，也应用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 句意：矿难夺去了其他几名矿工的生命，也让他右耳失聪。life生命，可数名词；根据“several other miners”可知，多人的生命应用名词复数形式 lives。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词在表示多者概念时，应用复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：黑暗、恐惧和孤独充斥着他的矿工生涯。根据“Darkness, fear and loneliness filled his work as...miner.”可知，此处泛指身份“作为一个矿工”，且 miner 以辅音音素开头，应用不定冠词 a。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指单数可数名词且以辅音音素开头时，前面用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 句意：迄今为止，他已出版了几部广受好评的著作。publish出版，动词；根据时间状语“so far”可知，这句话用现在完成时，结构为has/have done。
questions.rule_summary: 看到时间状语 so far（迄今为止），通常选用现在完成时 (has/have done)。

questions.explanation: 句意：尽管陈年喜生活艰难，但他的诗作却充满希望与力量。根据后文“his poetry has a feeling of hope”的转折逻辑可知，这句话是一个让步状语从句，表示“虽然……但是……”；此处应用 although/though。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“虽然、尽管”引导让步状语从句时，常用 although 或 though。

questions.explanation: 句意：他希望自己的作品能帮助现代人开阔视野，并提醒他们有时也要低头看看。they他们/她们/它们，主格形式；根据“minds”可知，此处应用形容词性物主代词修饰名词 minds，指代“modern people's”，故填 their。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词时，人称代词需转化为对应的形容词性物主代词。

sections.title: 人与自然 - Passage 1
raw_text: Giraffes are the world's tallest land animal.
At birth, a baby giraffe is about 1.8 metres tall and weighs about 68 kilograms.
A giraffe's tongue is usually black, blue 231. ________ purple.
It can be about 50 cm long.
That means the animal can use its tongue 232. ________ (get) food high in the tree.
Healthy giraffes can live about 25 years in the wild.
In the zoo, they can live 28 years or longer.
Giraffes often live in groups of 10 to 20.
A group of giraffes is called a "tower".
Giraffes' groups can change every day, even from hour 233. ________ hour.
A "tower" of giraffes you see today might not be the same one you see tomorrow.
It's amazing, isn't it?
Living in groups offers many 234. ________ (advantage) to giraffes.
It helps giraffes share information about food and water and provides 235. ________ (safe) in numbers in a "tower".
Giraffes play 236. ________ important role in nature.
But now they are in trouble.
The number of giraffes is getting smaller.
People 237. ________ (hunt) giraffes for a long time for their meat, coats and tails.
Habitat loss is 238. ________ (big) problem among the ones they face now.
Giraffes are 239. ________ (true) special animals.
Learning about the problems they face helps us protect them.
By sharing these wonderful facts, we can help do something to make sure giraffes and 240. ________ (they) homes are safe for the future.
filled_text: Giraffes are the world's tallest land animal.
At birth, a baby giraffe is about 1.8 metres tall and weighs about 68 kilograms.
A giraffe's tongue is usually black, blue or purple.
It can be about 50 cm long.
That means the animal can use its tongue to get food high in the tree.
Healthy giraffes can live about 25 years in the wild.
In the zoo, they can live 28 years or longer.
Giraffes often live in groups of 10 to 20.
A group of giraffes is called a "tower".
Giraffes' groups can change every day, even from hour to hour.
A "tower" of giraffes you see today might not be the same one you see tomorrow.
It's amazing, isn't it?
Living in groups offers many advantages to giraffes.
It helps giraffes share information about food and water and provides safety in numbers in a "tower".
Giraffes play an important role in nature.
But now they are in trouble.
The number of giraffes is getting smaller.
People have hunted giraffes for a long time for their meat, coats and tails.
Habitat loss is the biggest problem among the ones they face now.
Giraffes are truly special animals.
Learning about the problems they face helps us protect them.
By sharing these wonderful facts, we can help do something to make sure giraffes and their homes are safe for the future.
filled_text_cn: 长颈鹿是世界上最高的陆生动物。
出生时，长颈鹿宝宝身高约1.8米，体重约68公斤。
长颈鹿的舌头通常是黑色、蓝色或紫色的。
它可以长约50厘米。
这意味着这种动物可以用舌头在树的高处觅食。
健康的长颈鹿在野外可以活大约25年。
在动物园里，它们可以活28年或更久。
长颈鹿通常成群生活，每群10到20只。
一群长颈鹿被称为“塔”。
长颈鹿的群体每天甚至每小时都在变化。
你今天看到的“塔”长颈鹿可能和明天看到的不同。
这太神奇了，不是吗？
群居给长颈鹿带来了许多优势。
它帮助长颈鹿分享食物和水的信息，并在群体中提供数量上的安全。
长颈鹿在自然界中扮演着重要的角色。
但现在它们陷入了困境。
长颈鹿的数量正在减少。
长期以来，人们为了它们的肉、皮毛和尾巴而猎杀长颈鹿。
栖息地丧失是它们现在面临的最大问题。
长颈鹿真的是很特别的动物。
了解它们面临的问题有助于我们保护它们。
通过分享这些美妙的事实，我们可以帮助做一些事情，以确保长颈鹿及其家园在未来是安全的。

questions.explanation: 句意：长颈鹿的舌头通常是黑色、蓝色或紫色的。根据语境可知，此处表示选择或并列关系，or“或者”符合。
questions.rule_summary: 并列连词用于连接并列的单词、短语或句子，根据前后逻辑选择合适的连词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：这意味着这种动物可以用舌头在树的高处觅食。use sth. to do sth.“用某物做某事”是固定搭配，应用不定式作目的状语。
questions.rule_summary: use sth. to do sth. 表示“用某物去做某事”，用不定式作目的状语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：长颈鹿的群体每天甚至每小时都可能变化。from...to...“从……到……”是固定搭配。
questions.rule_summary: from...to... 意为“从……到……”，常用于表示范围或时间的更迭。

questions.explanation: 句意：群居给长颈鹿带来许多优势。根据空前的“many”可知，此处需用可数名词的复数形式 advantages。
questions.rule_summary: many 修饰可数名词复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：它帮助长颈鹿分享食物和水的信息，并在“群体”中提供数量上的安全。分析句子结构可知，动词 provides 后接名词作宾语，safe 的名词形式为 safety“安全”。
questions.rule_summary: 及物动词后面通常接名词作宾语，形容词需派生为对应的名词形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：长颈鹿在自然界中扮演重要角色。play an important role in...“在……中扮演重要角色”是固定搭配，且 important 以元音音素开头，用 an。
questions.rule_summary: play an important role in... 是固定短语，元音音素前用不定冠词 an。

questions.explanation: 句意：人们长期以来猎杀长颈鹿以获取它们的肉、皮毛和尾巴。根据时间状语“for a long time”可知，句子应用现在完成时，主语 People 是复数，故填 have hunted。
questions.rule_summary: for a long time 常与现在完成时连用，表示动作从过去开始一直持续到现在。

questions.explanation: 句意：栖息地丧失是它们现在面临的最大问题。根据“among the ones they face now”可知，此处表示三者或以上的比较，应用最高级，且最高级前必须加定冠词 the，故填 the biggest。
questions.rule_summary: 在一定范围（among...）内进行比较时用最高级，且形容词最高级前通常要加定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: 句意：长颈鹿是非常特别的动物。分析句子结构可知，空处修饰形容词 special，应用副词形式 truly“真正地”。
questions.rule_summary: 副词用来修饰形容词、副词或动词，形容词变副词通常在词尾加 -ly。

questions.grammar_point_name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
questions.explanation: 句意：通过分享这些奇妙的事实，我们可以帮助做一些事情，以确保长颈鹿和它们的家园在未来是安全的。空后有名词 homes，应用形容词性物主代词 their“它们的”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词时用形容词性物主代词（如 their）。

sections.title: 人与自然 - Passage 2
raw_text: When it rains heavily, we can say "It's raining cats and dogs."
However, 241. ________ December 29, 2021, for people in Texarkana, U.S.A., it was "raining fish."
And this is not a joke.
On that day, a storm 242. ________ (hit) the town.
It left a lot of small fish on the ground.
This may sound fun.
However, this is not the 243. ________ (one) report on such strange weather in history.
In 2017, people in California, U.S.A., saw fish falling from the clouds over a primary school.
In 1921, frogs fell from 244. ________ sky over a city in Canada.
As early as 2,000 years ago, a writer from Rome had a 245. ________ (discuss) about storms and fish in his book.
So, how do these strange 246. ________ (event) happen?
According to scientists, they are caused by waterspouts.
Waterspouts are tornadoes that form or travel over open water.
The fast wind inside 247. ________ (they) lifts water up into the clouds.
At the same time, some light fish or frogs 248. ________ (lift), too.
The wind carries both the animals 249. ________ water over the land.
They fall onto the ground when the energy of the wind starts to become weak.
As a result, it "rains" animals.
If you want 250. ________ (know) more about the nature, come to read my new book.
filled_text: When it rains heavily, we can say "It's raining cats and dogs."
However, on December 29, 2021, for people in Texarkana, U.S.A., it was "raining fish."
And this is not a joke.
On that day, a storm hit the town.
It left a lot of small fish on the ground.
This may sound fun.
However, this is not the first report on such strange weather in history.
In 2017, people in California, U.S.A., saw fish falling from the clouds over a primary school.
In 1921, frogs fell from the sky over a city in Canada.
As early as 2,000 years ago, a writer from Rome had a discussion about storms and fish in his book.
So, how do these strange events happen?
According to scientists, they are caused by waterspouts.
Waterspouts are tornadoes that form or travel over open water.
The fast wind inside them lifts water up into the clouds.
At the same time, some light fish or frogs are lifted, too.
The wind carries both the animals and water over the land.
They fall onto the ground when the energy of the wind starts to become weak.
As a result, it "rains" animals.
If you want to know more about the nature, come to read my new book.
filled_text_cn: 当雨下得很大时，我们可以说“倾盆大雨”。
然而，在2021年12月29日，对于美国德克萨斯卡的人来说，却是“下鱼”。
这不是一个笑话。
那天，一场风暴袭击了这个城镇。
它在地上留下了许多小鱼。
这听起来可能很有趣。
然而，这并不是历史上第一份关于这种奇怪天气的报道。
2017年，美国加利福尼亚州的人们看到鱼从一所小学上空的云层中落下来。
1921年，加拿大一个城市的天空下起了青蛙。
早在2000年前，一位来自罗马的作家就在他的书中讨论了风暴和鱼。
那么，这些奇怪的事件是如何发生的呢？
据科学家称，它们是由水龙卷引起的。
水龙卷是在开阔水域形成或移动的龙卷风。
它们内部的风将水吹向云层。
同时，一些小鱼或青蛙也被抬起来了。
风把动物和水带到陆地上。
当风的能量开始变弱时，它们落到地上。
结果，动物像雨一样落下来。
如果你想更多地了解大自然，来读我的新书。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
questions.explanation: 句意：然而，在2021年12月29日，对于美国德克萨斯卡的人来说，却是“下鱼”。根据“December 29, 2021”可知，具体到某一天要用介词on，“on December 29, 2021”表示“在2021年12月29日”，符合语境。故填 on。
questions.rule_summary: 具体到某一天或某一天的早中晚时，介词用on。

questions.explanation: 句意：那天，一场风暴袭击了这个城镇。根据上下文可知，该句时态为一般过去时，“hit”的过去式仍是“hit”，意为“袭击”，“a storm hit the town”表示“一场风暴袭击了这个城镇”，符合语境。故填 hit。
questions.rule_summary: 根据时间状语或上下文语境（如 On that day），过去发生的动作应用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 句意：然而，这并不是历史上第一份关于这种奇怪天气的报道。根据语境可知，这里表示“第一份报道”，要用序数词，“one”的序数词是“first”，“the first report”表示“第一份报道”，符合语境。故填 first。
questions.rule_summary: 句中已有定冠词the修饰时，基数词变序数词直接填相应形式（如one -> first）。

questions.explanation: 句意：1921年，加拿大一个城市的天空下起了青蛙。根据固定短语“in the sky”（在天空中）可知，这里要用定冠词“the”。故填 the。
questions.rule_summary: 独一无二的事物或固定短语（如in the sky）前通常用定冠词the。

questions.explanation: 句意：早在2000年前，一位来自罗马的作家就在他的书中讨论了风暴和鱼。“a”表示一个，后面接可数名词单数，“discuss”是动词，其名词形式是“discussion”，“have a discussion about”表示“讨论关于……”，符合语境。故填 discussion。
questions.rule_summary: 冠词或形容词性物主代词后常接名词，动词需派生为名词形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：那么，这些奇怪的事件是如何发生的呢？根据上文提到的“下鱼”“青蛙从天空落下”等事件可知，这里指多种奇怪的事件，“event”是可数名词，“these”后面接可数名词复数，“event”的复数是“events”。故填 events。
questions.rule_summary: 名词前有these、those或some等复数修饰词时，可数名词要变成复数形式。

questions.explanation: 句意：它们内部的风将水吹向云层。根据语境可知，这里指代前面的“waterspouts”，作介词“inside”的宾语，要用宾格，“they”的宾格是“them”。故填 them。
questions.rule_summary: 介词或动词后的代词作宾语时，必须使用宾格形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：同时，一些小鱼或青蛙也被抬起来了。根据语境可知，“some light fish or frogs”和“lift”之间是被动关系，即“被抬起”，该句时态为一般现在时，所以要用一般现在时的被动语态，其结构是“am/is/are + 过去分词”，“some light fish or frogs”是复数，be动词用“are”，“lift”的过去分词是“lifted”。故填 are lifted。
questions.rule_summary: 主语是动作的承受者时，应用被动语态（be + done）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and / but / or / so)
questions.explanation: 句意：风把动物和水带到陆地上。“animals”和“water”是并列关系，“both...and...”表示“两者都”，符合语境。故填 and。
questions.rule_summary: 固定搭配 both...and... 表示“既……又……”，中间连接并列成分。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想更多地了解大自然，来读我的新书。根据固定短语“want to do sth.”可知，这里要用动词不定式，“know”的不定式是“to know”。故填 to know。
questions.rule_summary: 动词want后接宾语时，常跟动词不定式（want to do sth.）。
